tenders.leanTxt: Confirmed from the press: Hexagon is being built for SDAIA in Riyadh at 480 MW total power capacity, Tier IV certified by the Uptime Institute, and hosts 290+ government systems. The foundation stone was laid around 1 Jan 2026 and AlBawani was appointed main contractor (SaudiGulf Projects, 4 Jan 2026). Press also mentions renewables integration and liquid/hybrid cooling. NOT found: phasing, MEP subcontractor, genset quantities or ratings, or any open genset RFQ. Treat this as a pursuit rather than a dated tender. Next steps: (1) identify the MEP subcontractor and the design consultant from AlBawani; (2) get onto the approved vendor list for 'standby diesel generators, DCC rated'; (3) position QSK95 with the Uptime DCC rating, local assembly and service (IKTVA/local content), and genset + BESS to support the renewables story. Why Cummins could lose: mtu and Cat have strong Gulf hyperscale references, and Mitsubishi/Chinese-engine packagers compete hard on price in KSA.

- NOT PUBLISHED. The plan line says only 'supply, installation and maintenance of electric generators and their accessories'.
- INFERENCE: sets at MoE sites in Kuwait's six educational districts (Capital, Hawalli, Farwaniya, Ahmadi, Jahra, Mubarak Al-Kabeer): schools, MoE headquarters (new HQ in South Surra), stores in South Sabhan, and possibly exam/control centres. Kuwait supply is 50 Hz, 415/240 V (MEW regulations).
- INFERENCE: KWD 700,000 (about USD 2.27M) including maintenance would buy roughly 15-40 sets in the 100-500 kVA class plus ATS, cabling and a 1-3 year maintenance tail. It could also be a smaller number of 1-2 MVA sets for MoE HQ or data centres. The mix will only be known from the CAPT/MoE documents.
- Context (INFERENCE): the 2026 regional conflict (Kuwait reports missile/drone interceptions in September 2026, per the Kuwait Business Gate news ticker) and summer load-shedding raise the priority of standby power at schools and MoE buildings.

DATES & PROCESS
- The float date is not announced. INFERENCE: Kuwait's fiscal year runs April to March, so a line in the 2026/27 plan should float before 31 Mar 2027.
- It could come through either channel:
  (a) CAPT public tender, numbered 'ME/nn/2026/2027'. The digests show MoE tenders under this prefix, e.g. 'TENDER NO. ME/23/2025/2026 ... MINISTRY OF EDUCATION ... Relevant Fee KD 3500/- ... Initial Guarantee KD 62,000/- valid for 90 days in favor of CAPT'. CAPT timing is typically 6-12 weeks from document sale to closing, with a pre-tender meeting.
  (b) MoE 'practice' (ممارسة), numbered 'م م/nn/2026-2027', on bidsgate.moe.edu.kw. Practices close 10 working days after publication, with a pre-tender meeting the following Sunday.
- INFERENCE: KWD 700k is above the value MoE normally handles by practice, so route (a) CAPT is more likely.
- Watch list: CAPT 'opening tenders' filtered to MoE (capt.gov.kw returns 403 from this environment, so check from a Kuwait browser); the Indian Embassy weekly digest (indembkwt.gov.in/pdf/Tenders Issue NNNN.pdf, every Monday); and bidsgate.moe.edu.kw/BidsList.

COMMERCIAL TERMS (expected, from comparable MoE notices; not tender-specific)
- CAPT route: document fee KD 75-3,500 depending on size (ME/23/2025/2026 was KD 3,500 with a KD 62,000 bid bond for a large O&M job). Initial guarantee is a fixed KD amount valid 90 days in favour of CAPT. INFERENCE: roughly KD 7,000-14,000 (1-2%) for a KD 700k job. Final guarantee is typically 10% in Kuwait (not verified for this tender). Offers are valid 90 days.
- MoE practice route (verbatim from MoE practice M.M/25/2026-2027): 'المقابل المادي للحصول على نسخة من وثائق الممارسة ... (75) ... دينار', 'تأمين أولي لا يقل عن ... 2000 د.ك' as a certified cheque or bank LG from a Kuwaiti bank in favour of MoE. Bank guarantees must be in Arabic. Offers go to the tender box at the Supplies & Stores Dept, South Sabhan.

ELIGIBILITY
- MoE practices are open only to 'الممارسين المعتمدين لدى وزارة التربية' (MoE-certified bidders). The bidder must be a specialised company inside Kuwait, registered in the Commercial Registry and Kuwait Chamber of Commerce for the current year, with relevant experience and trained technical staff.
- CAPT tenders require CAPT registration in the matching category. Standard CAPT and KISR notices also require a National Manpower (PAM) certificate and a PAM 'to whom it may concern' certificate showing the company file is not suspended. SMEs get a fee exemption.
- A foreign OEM cannot bid directly. INFERENCE: Cummins Arabia's Kuwait entity (formerly GTE, part of the Cummins Arabia JV per cummins.com) can bid if it holds CAPT/MoE registration. Otherwise it supplies a registered Kuwaiti electromechanical contractor.

PAST MoE GENERATOR TENDERS
- None found. There is no MoE generator tender in 160 digest issues (only DGCA, MEW, MoI, KISR, PAAET-type generator notices) and no MoE generator practice among 470 practices since Sep 2024. The nearest MoE practices are M.M/23/2024-2025 and M.M/34/2024-2025, which cover 'bowling (paging), surveillance, sound and uninterruptible power supply systems' at schools in the Capital and Mubarak Al-Kabeer districts (UPS, not gensets).
- INFERENCE: this plan line is a new MoE purchase category, so there is no incumbent generator contractor.

COMPETITORS
- Caterpillar through Al-Bahar (albahar.com: exclusive Cat dealer in 'UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman and Bahrain').
- mtu through Al Mulla Power Solutions, the authorised mtu distributor in Kuwait. It claims '200+ mtu units' in Kuwait including '45 Series 4000 gensets at Kuwait International Airport' and Jahra Hospital.
- Perkins through Al-Nisf Equipment Co (authorised Perkins parts distributor in Kuwait) and local packagers such as Ali Al Dousari (DME Generators, Perkins gensets).
- Kuwaiti electromechanical contractors quoting Chinese-engine sets on price.
- MoE award is generally the lowest compliant price.

HOW CUMMINS WINS
1. This month, confirm registration. Does Cummins Arabia Kuwait hold CAPT registration in the electrical/generator category and MoE 'certified bidder' status on bidsgate.moe.edu.kw? If not, apply now; it is the gating item.
2. Ask the MoE Maintenance Dept (إدارة الصيانة) / Educational Facilities sector for the scope: sites, kVA and whether maintenance covers existing sets and their makes.
3. Prepare a school standby package: C-series 50 Hz sets 100-500 kVA with canopy, ATS and PowerCommand controls, a 3-year maintenance rate card, and genuine parts stocked in Kuwait.
4. Line up 2-3 MoE-registered Kuwaiti contractors with exclusive pricing in case MoE requires a local contractor.
5. Track the Indian Embassy digest weekly for 'ME/' plus 'generators', and bid within the 10-day practice window or the CAPT window.

RISKS
- The plan line may never float, or may be split into small practices below the Cummins-worthwhile size.
- Lowest-price award favours Chinese or Perkins local packages.
- mtu/Al Mulla and Cat/Al-Bahar have a strong Kuwaiti government installed base.
- CAPT is not reachable from outside Kuwait, so tracking depends on the digests.
- Scope is unknown; it may be mostly maintenance with little new supply.

tenders.leanTxt:
WHAT IT IS
- Etimad tender 2026100104, ref 260939000299: 'إحلال وتأمين مصادر التغذية الإحتياطية لمستشفى حوطة بني تميم بالرياض'. Buyer: MoH General Directorate ('ديوان الوزارة، الإدارة العامة للعقود والمشتريات'). Published 16 Sep 2026; status 'معتمدة'; no award result ('لم يتم اعلان نتائج الترسية بعد').
- Hospital: Hawtat Bani Tamim General Hospital, Al-Salamiyah, Hawtat Bani Tamim 16511, part of the Riyadh First Health Cluster. Per the cluster portal page as summarised by search (the page itself failed to load here), it has 'a capacity of 100 beds' with ER, ICU, internal medicine, general surgery, OB/GYN and paediatrics incl. neonatal care, and is the referral hospital for 11 health centres. Al-Riyadh (alriyadh.com/1871214) reported 210,273 beneficiaries in a year (headline only).

SCOPE & RATINGS
- NOT PUBLIC. The booklet and BOQ are behind the supplier login.
- Etimad classification: activity 'إمدادات الكهرباء والغاز والمياه والبخار وتكييف الهواء'; 'تشمل المنافسة على بنود توريد: لا'; work types 'أعمال الإنشاء' and 'أعمال الصيانة والتشغيل'.
- INFERENCE: for a 100-bed general hospital, 2-3 diesel standby sets of about 800-1,500 kVA, 60 Hz LV, with synchronising panel, ATS, day and bulk tanks, plus replacement electrical works and 18 months of O&M. Programme award values of SAR 15-18M for similar-size hospitals imply a wider scope than gensets alone (probably MV/LV switchgear, cabling, civil works, possibly UPS or rotary UPS).

DATES & PROCESS (Etimad, read 29 Sep 2026)
- Questions from 27/09/2026; last enquiries 08/10/2026 (27/04/1448); answers within 5 days.
- Offers due 18/10/2026 (07/05/1448) 09:00 AM; opening 18/10/2026 10:00 AM at 'بمبنى ديوان الوزارة القديم بطريق الملك عبدالعزيز (المبنى الرئيسي ـ الدور الأول) إدارة المنافسات'. No separate examination date.
- Standstill 5 days; expected award 12/01/2027; start 19/01/2027; 18 months, so INFERENCE: completion around July 2028.
- Two separate envelopes (technical and financial). Programme history shows the technical envelope is decisive.

COMMERCIAL TERMS
- Booklet SAR 1,000.00 (the listing API field shows 500). Initial guarantee required (% in booklet; INFERENCE 1-2% under GTPL). Final guarantee 5%. Insurance not required.

ELIGIBILITY
- Contractor classification, field 'قطاع التشييد والبناء'. Site inside KSA, Riyadh region, Hawtat Bani Tamim.
- Local content: 'القائمة الإلزامية' + 'تفضيل المنشآت الصغيرة والمتوسطة'.

MoH PROGRAMME HISTORY (Etimad awarding-results component, public, read 29 Sep 2026). The same MoH General Directorate for Contracts & Procurement has run 'إحلال وتأمين مصادر التغذية الإحتياطية (الكهربائية)' tenders since 2021. Awarded contracts (SAR, award value):
- Al-Namas General (2022100042): Abdullah Abunayyan Trading, 15,099,999.10
- Al-Majardah General (2022100029): Abdulrahman Saad Al-Rashid & Sons, 14,999,999.70
- Al-Aflaj General (2022100031): Abunayyan, bid 16,843,567 negotiated to 14,837,231
- Samtah General (2022100030): Abunayyan, 17,999,998.95
- Farasan General (2022100028): Abunayyan, bid 19,736,645 negotiated to 17,579,061
- Sarat Abidah (2022100171): Al-Rashid & Sons, 23,998,095.35
- King Khalid Hospital Hail (2022100190): Noor Energy (شركة نور للطاقة), 22,947,686.50
- King Khalid Hospital Najran (2022100172): Al-Rashid & Sons, 31,999,998.90
- Al-Qurayyat General (2023100423): Al Rashid Technology & Power (ATP), 15,222,669.60
- Huraymila General (2024100257): Advanced Systems Projects (الأنظمة المتقدمة للمشاريع), 16,845,775
- Al-Noor Hospital Makkah (2024100220): ATP, 31,467,253.35
- King Salman Hospital Riyadh (2025100197): ATP, bid 23,072,080.85 negotiated to 21,150,000
Patterns (from these results):
- The Al-Rashid group (ARTAR / ATP) won 6 of 12 and Abunayyan 4 of 12.
- The technical envelope decides: many of the lowest bids were ruled 'غير مطابق' (non-compliant). Examples: Huraymila, where 6 of 13 bids failed, including the lowest at 12.56M; Al-Noor, where 7 of 9 failed.
- MoH negotiates the winner down in some awards.
- Other regular bidders: Alfanar, SATIC (ساتيك), Alkhorayef, Savana International, Power Source, Smart Protection, Nabd Digital Solutions, Al-Majd, Al-Lami', Energy Equipment Rental.
Genset affiliations:
- Abunayyan Trading is Kohler's exclusive power-systems distributor in KSA (Arab News/Saudi Gazette; abunayyantrading.com Kohler pages).
- Alkhorayef makes 'Gulf Power' gensets with Volvo Penta, John Deere and Baudouin engines (search summary of alkhorayefcommercial.com.sa).
- ATP (est. 2014 by ARTAR) does 'supply, testing and commissioning of Rotary UPS' (atp.sa). INFERENCE: some programme scopes may include diesel rotary UPS, not only gensets.
- The genset brands used on the Al-Rashid/ATP, Noor Energy and Advanced Systems awards are NOT known.
Stale or other programme items:
- King Khalid Hospital Tabuk (42001090015, 2021): still shows 'مرحلة الترسية' with no award, so treat as stale.
- The MoH Najran branch separately tendered 'توريد وتركيب كابلات المولدات الإحتياطية لمستشفى الملك خالد بنجران' (kkhp45/1445, Dec 2023).
Live and pending items as of 29 Sep 2026: Najran Maternity & Children (2026100101, closes 15 Oct), Hawtat Bani Tamim (2026100104, closes 18 Oct), MoH critical sites in 7 cities (2026100071, financial evaluation approved) and King Khalid Hospital Al-Majma'ah (2025100140, award stage).

HOW CUMMINS WINS
1. Now, and for every live tender: buy the booklet (SAR 1,000) through Cummins Arabia KSA's Etimad account. This gives the BOQ and approved-makes list and the list of booklet buyers. INFERENCE: purchase does not need the construction classification.
2. Price every non-Kohler serious bidder with the same package: Al-Rashid/ATP, Noor Energy, Advanced Systems Projects, Alfanar, SATIC, Alkhorayef. The package is 60 Hz QSK-class standby sets, PowerCommand paralleling and ATS, tanks, commissioning and an 18-month O&M/service plan. Abunayyan will quote Kohler, so treat it as a competitor, not a channel.
3. Win the technical envelope, where most bidders fail. Give partners a complete compliance pack: datasheets, NFPA 110 Level 1 / type-test evidence, local service references, the local-content certificate route, and a clause-by-clause compliance statement against the booklet.
4. Target the Al-Rashid group first. It won 6 of 12 and is the most likely next winner. Offer an MoH-programme framework price covering several hospitals.
5. After award, close the purchase order within the 5-day standstill and mobilisation window.
6. The enquiry window is still open until 8 Oct, unlike Najran. Use a partner's enquiry to ask MoH to confirm that 'equal and approved' gensets are accepted and that PowerCommand-type paralleling is compliant.

RISKS
- Mandatory-list (LCGPA) coverage of diesel gensets is not verified; if gensets are listed, a Saudi-made package is needed.
- Kohler/Abunayyan and Cat/Zahid have MoH programme references.
- The scope may include rotary UPS or MV works where Cummins has no share.
- Technical non-compliance knocks out most bidders, so the partner choice is critical.
- Award dates slip (Al-Majma'ah and Tabuk are overdue).

tenders.leanTxt:
WHAT IT IS
- DEWA open tender No. 2132600053: 'UPGRADATION OF STANDBY GENERATORS AT DISTRIBUTION CONTROL CENTER, QUASIS ON PLOT NO. 232-552 AND UPGRADATION OF STANDBY GENERATORS AT DISTRIBUTION CONTROL CENTER, WARSAN SECOND ON PLOT NO. 622-159'. Floating date 19-May-2026. Closing date 30-Jul-2026 (originally 02-Jul-2026 per TendersArabia TA-141576625 and TendersOnTime 141601730/141576625; extended per TA-144445009). Tender type: Open Tender. Offers were submitted online through DEWA SRM ('Tenderers are required to submit their offers online').
- The sites are DEWA's two electricity distribution control centres, which run Dubai's 33/11 kV network.
  - Warsan: DEWA (16 Oct 2011) described the Warsan centre as 'two buildings - one for electricity distribution control with the capacity of 33 KV and 11 KV, and the other for monitoring and controlling electricity generation and transmission (400/132 kV)'.
  - Al Qusais: 'the Control Centre at Al Qusais, which cost AED 29 million ... consists of two floors and includes distribution, planning, and coordination departments ... a simulator, and on-site distribution management' (Emirates 24|7 / Utilities ME, 22-23 Jan 2014). The two centres run as a 'Multi-Site System' backing each other up in an emergency.
  - Both opened in January 2014. INFERENCE: the standby sets being upgraded are about 12-13 years old (installed around 2012-2013).

STATUS & BIDS (DEWA Tender Opening Results page, saved 29 Sep 2026; seven offers, not six)
 01 DANWAY LLC: AED 7,497,000.00; '13 MONTHS INCLUDING 15 DAYS MOBILISATION'; bank guarantee RECEIVED; online offer.
 02 GALADARI ENERGY SOLUTIONS LLC: AED 3,872,910.00 (lowest); completion blank; bank guarantee RECEIVED.
 03 KANOO ENERGY L.L.C: AED 6,300,000.00; '40 WEEKS'; bank guarantee RECEIVED.
 04 PRECISION INDUSTRIES LLC: AED 6,847,260.00; 13 months incl. 15 days mobilisation; bank guarantee RECEIVED.
 05 YUKON INTERNATIONAL CONTRACTING LLC: AED 10,747,350.32; 13 months incl. 15 days mobilisation; 'DISCOUNTED OFFER, 2% DISCOUNT OFFERED'.
 06 JUBAILI BROS. LLC: 'REGRET'.
 07 AL MASAOOD L.L.C.: 'REGRET'. Al Masaood is the mtu (Rolls-Royce Power Systems) distributor in the UAE.
- No award is published yet; there was no award notice on DEWA's page at 29 Sep 2026. The DEWA page says: 'The Total Price(s) and details of the offers ... are as indicated by the Tenderers ... no request for any further information about any offer shall be entertained.'
- Award timing, INFERENCE: DEWA runs technical evaluation and then commercial evaluation. With opening on 30 Jul 2026 and a typical 2-4 month evaluation, the award is likely in Oct-Nov 2026, possibly within weeks. Delivery or completion is 13 months or 40 weeks from award, so gensets would be needed on site about Q2-Q3 2027.

SCOPE & RATINGS
- NOT PUBLIC. Set count, kVA, voltage, enclosure, fuel system and ATS/sync scope are in the DEWA SRM tender documents, which are login-only.
- INFERENCE from building type and bid values: each DCC probably has 2 (N+1) or 3 sets, each about 800-2,000 kVA, 50 Hz, 400/230 V LV (or 11 kV), with paralleling/synchronising switchboards, AMF/ATS, day and bulk tanks, and stack/acoustic works. 'Upgradation' can mean full replacement plus controls, or re-engining or controls retrofit. The 13-month durations and AED 3.9-10.7M prices point to replacement of the sets plus electrical and civil works at two live sites.
- Genset share, INFERENCE: about 40-60% of contract value, i.e. AED 1.5-4.5M (USD 0.4-1.2M).

COMMERCIAL TERMS
- Online submission on DEWA SRM, and a tender bond (bank guarantee) was required: DEWA shows 'Bank Guarante RECEIVED' for the five priced offers.
- The bond amount (AED 200,000 in the earlier record) is NOT VERIFIED. The public TendersArabia TA-144445009 page shows no bond ('Tender Value: Refer Document', 'Document Cost: 0.00'). The document fee shows as 0.00 AED on TendersArabia.
- Performance bond, warranty and retention terms are not public.

ELIGIBILITY
- The public notice says: open tender, bidders registered as DEWA suppliers on SRM. Licensing class and genset approved-makes list are not public. INFERENCE: DEWA specs for critical facilities usually require an OEM with local service and DEWA-approved makes; check the approved vendor list.

BIDDERS AND THEIR LIKELY GENSET BRANDS (sourced where stated; otherwise INFERENCE)
- Galadari Energy Solutions (L1). A Galadari Brothers subsidiary and distributor of Atlas Copco and Baudouin. Its own 'GES' generators are 'powered by Baudouin engines' (galadarienergy.com/brand/ges; the page title also says 'Komatsu and Perkins Generators in UAE'). INFERENCE: its AED 3.87M price almost certainly uses GES/Baudouin sets, so Cummins cannot supply this bidder unless DEWA's approved-makes list forces a change.
- Kanoo Energy L.L.C (L2). Part of the Kanoo group (Kanoo Industrial & Energy). Its sister company Kanoo Machinery 'exclusively manages the business for Perkins engines across the Middle East region'. INFERENCE: likely Perkins-engined sets, probably through Kanoo Machinery. The 40-week delivery fits imported 4000-series lead times. The earlier record's 'Cat-linked' wording is imprecise: Perkins is Caterpillar-owned, but the UAE Cat dealer is Al-Bahar.
- Precision Industries LLC (L3). A Dubai genset OEM in Al Quoz, founded 2005 (Beta Holding). Its site states: 'Cummins & Perkins Authorised Official Sales & Service Partner'; 'strategic agreements with ... Cummins, Stamford, and Leroy-Somer in 2014 and Perkins in 2017'; product filter lists Perkins (171), Cummins (55), Yuchai (72), Mitsubishi (19) models; range 10-4,000 kVA. This is the natural Cummins channel. Which engine it quoted is unknown.
- Danway LLC (L4). A Dubai electrical and mechanical contractor with DEWA 132/11 kV substation track record ('energized its 24th 132/11KV ... Substation in the DEWA network'). It has no own genset brand, so the OEM is open (INFERENCE).
- Yukon International Contracting LLC (L5, highest). A Deira-based EPCC/MEP contractor (est. 2017). No genset brand; OEM open (INFERENCE).

1. Precision Industries (priority): confirm this week whether PI's offer is Cummins-engined. If it is, lock in engine, alternator and PowerCommand pricing, delivery slots and DEWA-grade service commitments so PI can hold price through clarification. If it quoted Perkins or Yuchai, offer a Cummins QSK-based alternative at matched price for any DEWA-requested re-offer or post-award substitution.
2. Kanoo Energy (L2): offer Cummins as a faster-delivery or approved-make alternative if Galadari is disqualified technically. Kanoo is likely tied to Perkins, so the odds are low to medium.
3. Galadari (L1): low odds. The only opening is if DEWA's technical evaluation rejects the Baudouin/GES offer or requires an approved make; have a compliant Cummins package ready to pitch to the next-ranked bidders.

5. DEWA side: make sure Cummins gensets are on DEWA Distribution's approved list. data-centre-continuous-prime-power.t: Baudouin positions 1,900 to 6,250 kVA range for hyperscale campuses and pushes lead time as the decisive variable
data-centre-continuous-prime-power.impact: [Analysis] No visible Cummins Arabia answer yet. This is the sales script Cummins Arabia will meet in Gulf data centre bids: a bigger single unit and a shorter delivery slot. Cummins Arabia needs firm factory slot commitments in its proposals and should quantify Cummins' service network and parts stock in KSA and UAE against Baudouin's thin local footprint.
data-centre-continuous-prime-power.compNote: Where Cummins Arabia stands in this area: Cummins holds the 73.2 MW Saudi hyperscale reference (30 DQLC + 6 DQCA) and the Centum range (S17 Centum, QSK78 and QSK95 based C2750D6E to C3500D6E) with DCC ratings, but Caterpillar 3516E and C175, mtu Series 4000, Rehlko KD and Baudouin M55 all publish competing data centre cards and several have signed multi-GW frameworks that consume capacity through 2027.

data-centre-continuous-prime-power.t: Baudouin publishes November 2025 data centre genset rating cards (50 and 60 Hz) covering WPG1900 to WPG5775
data-centre-continuous-prime-power.body: The 50 Hz card runs from WPG1900 (16M33G1900, 1,925 kVA DCR) to WPG5775 (20M61G5940, 5,250 kVA DCP at 11 kV); the 60 Hz card runs from WPG1540B76 (1,925 kVA DCR) to WPG5000B76 (20M61G5000, 6,250 kVA DCR at 13.8 kV). EPA Tier 2 genset models are available.
data-centre-continuous-prime-power.impact: [Analysis] No visible Cummins Arabia answer yet. The 60 Hz card matters for Saudi Arabia: Baudouin now publishes DCR and DCP ratings at 1800 rpm including 13.8 kV medium voltage sets, which is what Saudi data centre specifications ask for. Cummins Arabia should benchmark its 60 Hz C2500 to C3500 DCC offers against the WPG2500B76 to WPG4000B76 band.

data-centre-continuous-prime-power.body: Perkins showcased the 2606 (350 to 550 kVA at 50 Hz, available H2 2025, 1,000 hour service intervals, HVO and B100 capable) and the electronic 5012 (1,275 to 1,875 kVA at 50 Hz, 1,125 to 1,500 kWe at 60 Hz, ISO G3, NFPA110, EPA Tier 2 on 60 Hz). Applications cited: data centres, hospitals, power plants.
data-centre-continuous-prime-power.impact: [Analysis] Cummins Arabia has an answer. The 5012 sits exactly on the 1,250 to 1,875 kVA band where Cummins Arabia sells QSK50 and QSK60 based sets into data centres and hospitals, and it is offered to every independent packager in the Gulf. The 2606 attacks the 350 to 550 kVA band with 1,000 hour service intervals. Cummins Arabia should benchmark total cost of ownership against 5012-powered Jubaili and Teksan sets and lead with factory-packaged reliability, local service coverage and 50 degree C ambient performance.

data-centre-continuous-prime-power.impact: [Analysis] Cummins Arabia has an answer. A plug-in containerised 2.5 MVA set is the format UAE and Kuwait colocation builders ask for. Cummins Arabia should have a matching containerised C2500 or C2750 offer priced and documented for 50 Hz markets before Mitsubishi dealers bring this to Dubai.
data-centre-continuous-prime-power.whatsNew: Up to 2,500 kVA standby in a 40 ft high cube container, Critical Power and Data Center Continuous Power duty, Tier III and Tier IV compliant, launched at Data Centre World Asia 2025 in Singapore with an APAC 50 Hz focus.
data-centre-continuous-prime-power.compNote: Where Cummins Arabia stands in this area: Cummins holds the 73.2 MW Saudi hyperscale reference (30 DQLC + 6 DQCA) and the Centum range (S17 Centum, QSK78 and QSK95 based C2750D6E to C3500D6E) with DCC ratings, but Caterpillar 3516E and C175, mtu Series 4000, Rehlko KD and Baudouin M55 all publish competing data centre cards and several have signed multi-GW frameworks that consume capacity through 2027.

data-centre-continuous-prime-power.t: Upgraded mtu Series 1600 gensets launched for 50 Hz market, 590 to 996 kVA
data-centre-continuous-prime-power.body: New 12V1600 Gx1 based gensets deliver up to 40% more power than the predecessor, are approved for HVO (EN 15940), meet ISO 8528-5 class G3 and carry 100% load factor ratings for data centre use. Aimed at data centres, healthcare, commercial buildings and edge sites; the 60 Hz version launched in late 2023.
data-centre-continuous-prime-power.impact: [Analysis] Cummins Arabia has an answer. This pushes mtu down into the 600 to 1,000 kVA band where Cummins Arabia sells QSX15 and QSK23 based sets in volume for UAE and Kuwait 50 Hz projects. mtu's argument is data centre grade load factors and HVO approval on a compact 22 litre engine. Cummins Arabia should hold the position on price, lead time and local stock, which mtu's distributors cannot match in this band.

data-centre-continuous-prime-power.t: MHIET launches MGS3100R, a 3,000 kVA class set with common rail S16R2 engine
data-centre-continuous-prime-power.body: MGS3100R rated 3,025 kVA standby / critical power and 2,750 kVA prime / data centre continuous at 50 Hz, 6,785 x 2,820 x 3,170 mm, 23,100 kg dry, ISO 8528-5 G3 and NFPA 110, assembled in Singapore and Vietnam for factories, hospitals and data centres in Asia Pacific. MHIET stated MGS had sold over 12,000 units to date.
data-centre-continuous-prime-power.impact: [Analysis] Cummins Arabia has an answer. This is Mitsubishi's answer to the 2.5 MW to 3 MW data centre node that Cummins serves with QSK78 and QSK95 based sets. It is not yet on the Middle East catalogue, which caps Mitsubishi's Gulf offer at 2,750 kVA until MHIES-ME adopts MGS-R. Cummins Arabia should keep quoting above 2.75 MVA where Mitsubishi cannot follow locally.

MHIET stated MGS had sold over 12,000 units to date.

data-centre-continuous-prime-power.t: Volvo Penta launches D17, its most powerful genset engine (TWD1744GE, 758 kVA prime at 50 Hz) (baseline)
data-centre-continuous-prime-power.body: 17.26 litre six cylinder with dual-stage turbochargers and common rail, EPA Tier 2 certified for stationary emergency, dual speed 1500/1800 rpm, service interval up to 1,000 hours; 50 Hz prime 758 kVA, standby 833 kVA; 60 Hz prime 801 kVA, standby 881 kVA.
data-centre-continuous-prime-power.impact: [Analysis] Cummins Arabia has an answer. Lifts Volvo's ceiling to about 880 kVA standby at 60 Hz, which puts Volvo-powered packager sets against Cummins QSX15 and QSK23 based sets in Saudi commercial and industrial standby. Above that band Volvo has no offer.

data-centre-continuous-prime-power.t: USD 24 million Mankato expansion to lift Series 4000 genset output by more than 120% by 2026
data-centre-continuous-prime-power.body: Rolls-Royce announced a new Logistics Operations Center in Mankato, Minnesota to raise Series 4000 generator set production more than 120% by 2026 versus the prior year, adding over 100 jobs. Data centre sales grew almost 50% in 2024; Stratmann said hyperscale customers have relied on mtu for over 15 years.
data-centre-continuous-prime-power.impact: [Analysis] Cummins Arabia has an answer. Mankato builds 60 Hz sets, the frequency Saudi Arabia runs on. More 60 Hz Series 4000 capacity shortens the lead times mtu can quote into Saudi data centre and industrial tenders from 2026. Cummins Arabia's 60 Hz lead-time advantage in KSA narrows as this ramps.

data-centre-continuous-prime-power.t: USD 75 million Aiken, South Carolina expansion to machine Series 4000 engines in the US from July 2027
data-centre-continuous-prime-power.body: Phase 1 adds 37,000 sq ft (potential 60,000 sq ft) to the Aiken engine plant so Series 4000 components are machined in-country instead of shipped finished from Germany. Construction starts Q1 2026, production July 2027, 60 new jobs on a 434 person site.
data-centre-continuous-prime-power.impact: [Analysis] Cummins Arabia has an answer. A second Series 4000 engine source reduces mtu's single-plant dependency on Friedrichshafen, which has historically capped what its Gulf distributors could deliver in a given year. Monitor mtu lead-time quotes in KSA and UAE from 2027.

data-centre-continuous-prime-power.t: MTU Yuchai Power JV in Suzhou adds Series 2000 G06 and Series 4000 S83 production, 3,000 engines built to date
data-centre-continuous-prime-power.body: Rolls-Royce's Chinese JV with Guangxi Yuchai, established 2014, expanded its scope in 2024 and now builds Series 2000 and 4000 variants for data centres, rental, industrial parks and oil and gas, including for overseas projects in neighbouring regions.
data-centre-continuous-prime-power.impact: [Analysis] Cummins Arabia has an answer. Chinese built mtu engines create a lower cost route for Chinese genset packagers exporting to the Gulf. Cummins Arabia already competes with Chinese packaged Cummins engines from Cummins' own China plants; mtu now has a comparable lever. Watch for Suzhou sourced mtu gensets appearing in UAE and KSA rental and construction tenders.

data-centre-continuous-prime-power.t: Cummins introduces QSK78 Centum Series to the 50 Hz market
data-centre-continuous-prime-power.body: New 50 Hz HHP Centum gensets on the QSK78 platform, up to 3500 kVA standby and 3300 kVA continuous for data centres, with PowerCommand 3400, Centum Transmission Drive, Tier 2 and Low NOx options and HVO compatibility, announced from Daventry, UK for Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia Pacific and Latin America.
data-centre-continuous-prime-power.impact: [Analysis] Cummins Arabia's own position. Extends the data-centre-optimised Centum footprint to the 50 Hz UAE and Kuwait markets where the C2750D5 and C3000D5 previously carried the QSK78 range. Cummins Arabia should obtain the model data sheets and position the 3300 kVA continuous rating against Cat 3516E and mtu 20V4000 offers in UAE hyperscale tenders.

manufacturing-capacity-localisation.t: Liebherr expands Colmar engine plant for Rehlko KD Series data centre demand
manufacturing-capacity-localisation.body: Ceremony at Liebherr-Components Colmar marked a nearly 12,000 square metre extension; engine production capacity for Rehlko will more than double once fully ramped. Rehlko cited a growing backlog to convert into long-term revenue.
manufacturing-capacity-localisation.impact: [Analysis] No visible Cummins Arabia answer yet. Engine supply was the constraint on KD Series volume. Doubling it removes a lead time argument Cummins Arabia could previously use in the 2 MW to 4 MW band. Expect more aggressive KD availability quotes into Gulf data centre projects from 2027.
manufacturing-capacity-localisation.whatsNew: Ceremony at Liebherr-Components Colmar marked a nearly 12,000 square metre extension; engine production capacity for Rehlko will more than double once fully ramped. Rehlko cited a growing backlog to convert into long-term revenue.
manufacturing-capacity-localisation.compNote: Where Cummins Arabia stands in this area: Cummins is adding high-horsepower capacity through 2030 but has no Saudi assembly; mtu's Makeen JV holds a Saudi manufacturing licence, Mitsubishi Power assembles in Dammam, FG Wilson assembles in Jebel Ali, Jubaili Bros manufactures in KSA, and Rehlko and Weichai are doubling Chinese output aimed at EMEA.

manufacturing-capacity-localisation.t: Caterpillar commits USD 725 million to expand Lafayette large engine plant for 3500 series power generation engines
manufacturing-capacity-localisation.body: USD 725 million capital expansion at the Lafayette, Indiana large engine centre that builds Cat 3500 engines for power generation and data centre applications, plus a USD 100 million five-year US workforce pledge.
manufacturing-capacity-localisation.impact: [Analysis] No visible Cummins Arabia answer yet. The 3512 and 3516 are the engines behind the gensets Cummins Arabia meets most often in Gulf tenders. More 3500 capacity shortens Cat lead times from 2027, which removes one of the few advantages Cummins has held while Cat allocated engines to US hyperscalers.

manufacturing-capacity-localisation.t: Q1 2026: Caterpillar triples large reciprocating engine capacity plan to about 3x 2024 levels, adds about 15 GW per year, power generation +48%
manufacturing-capacity-localisation.body: Q1 2026 sales USD 17.4 billion (+22%), Power & Energy USD 7 billion (+22%), power generation sales +48%; large engine capacity plan raised from 2x to nearly 3x 2024 levels with investment mainly 2027 to 2029, about 15 GW of additional annual capacity; large engine backlog up 3.5x since January 2024; tariff cost guidance cut to USD 2.2 to 2.4 billion; six agreements of at least 1 GW each announced; EAME outlook noted softening anticipated in the Middle East.
manufacturing-capacity-localisation.impact: [Analysis] No visible Cummins Arabia answer yet. This is the structural threat. By 2028 Cat will have far more 3500, C175 and G3500 engine supply than today and will need non-US outlets for it, and the Gulf is the obvious one. Cummins Arabia should lock multi-year supply agreements and service contracts with key Saudi and UAE accounts in 2026 and 2027 while Cat is still capacity constrained.

manufacturing-capacity-localisation.t: Mankato logistics centre opens; Series 4000 genset capacity more than doubles by end 2026
manufacturing-capacity-localisation.body: Rolls-Royce cut the ribbon on the 250,000 sq ft, USD 24 million Logistics Operations Center in Mankato, stating genset production capacity more than doubles by end of 2026 and that its backup systems support more than 25% of US data centres.
manufacturing-capacity-localisation.impact: [Analysis] No visible Cummins Arabia answer yet. Doubled 60 Hz Series 4000 output is the supply side of a future push into Saudi Arabia's 60 Hz data centre market. Lead time, not product, has been mtu's Gulf weakness; from 2027 that argument weakens for Cummins Arabia in KSA.

manufacturing-capacity-localisation.t: Rehlko opens Kenosha, Wisconsin assembly for eFRAME enclosures up to 4 MW
manufacturing-capacity-localisation.body: New facility for integrated eFRAME enclosures for backup generator solutions up to 4 MW, with plans to expand capacity by more than 400% through the decade; initial production late 2026, full capacity early 2027.
manufacturing-capacity-localisation.impact: [Analysis] No visible Cummins Arabia answer yet. Capacity is being added for enclosed 4 MW packages, the format hyperscalers specify. This is North American capacity, so lead time relief for Gulf orders would come from Brest and Changzhou instead. Cummins Arabia should track quoted lead times from Rehlko distributors on 2.5 MW to 4 MW enclosed sets.

manufacturing-capacity-localisation.t: Rehlko launches programme to double Changzhou backup power capacity from 5.5 GW to 11 GW
manufacturing-capacity-localisation.body: Changzhou builds generator systems from 6 kW to 4,000 kW and key components, serving China, Southeast Asia, EMEA and Latin America; CEO called it a critical hub for EMEA. The 11 GW target is to be reached without expanding the footprint; first pass yield up from 93% to 98%.
manufacturing-capacity-localisation.impact: [Analysis] No visible Cummins Arabia answer yet. Changzhou explicitly serves EMEA, so Gulf distributors can now source KD Series up to 4,000 kW from a plant with 11 GW annual capacity. This is a direct supply and price lever against Cummins Arabia in KSA, UAE and Kuwait data centre and industrial tenders. Cummins Arabia should benchmark Changzhou-sourced pricing on 1.5 MW to 3 MW sets and reinforce total cost of ownership and local service arguments.

manufacturing-capacity-localisation.t: MHI-ESA adds MGS assembly plant in Johor Bahru, Malaysia with WDG Assembly
manufacturing-capacity-localisation.body: New production hub for MGS units to meet rising data centre and critical infrastructure demand in Southeast Asia, alongside Singapore and Vietnam assembly.
manufacturing-capacity-localisation.impact: [Analysis] No visible Cummins Arabia answer yet. Extra MGS capacity in Asia shortens lead times for Gulf orders that ship from Singapore. Cummins Arabia should expect Mitsubishi dealers in KSA and UAE to quote firmer delivery on 1.5 MVA to 2.75 MVA sets.

manufacturing-capacity-localisation.t: Generac buys Belvidere, Illinois plant to add large-megawatt genset packaging capacity from Q1 2027, after February 2026 Enercon acquisition
manufacturing-capacity-localisation.body: The facility adds over 100 jobs and follows the acquisition of Enercon Engineering (enclosures and switchgear) and expansions in Oshkosh, Beaver Dam and Sussex.
manufacturing-capacity-localisation.impact: [Analysis] No visible Cummins Arabia answer yet. More US packaging capacity shortens Generac lead times for export orders in 2027. Cummins Arabia should expect Generac to quote competitive delivery on Gulf hyperscale sites from 2027.

gas-dual-fuel-gensets.t: Modular mtu gas engine power plants launched in 10, 20 and 30 MW blocks, 12 to 18 months to grid
gas-dual-fuel-gensets.body: Preconfigured, factory-tested 20V4000 L64 modules deliver plants from 5 MW to several hundred MW, hydrogen-ready and biomethane capable, for utilities, data centres and industry. Rolls-Royce cites 17 GW plus of installed gas capacity and 500 mtu gas gensets in the UK.
gas-dual-fuel-gensets.impact: [Analysis] No visible Cummins Arabia answer yet. Modular gas blocks with a 12 to 18 month schedule are aimed at exactly the bridging power tenders that Saudi and UAE data centre developers are issuing while grid connections lag. Cummins Arabia's HSK78G offers competitive efficiency but Cummins has not published a comparable pre-engineered block product; Cummins Arabia should build a reference 10 MW HSK78G block design with local balance of plant partners.
gas-dual-fuel-gensets.whatsNew: Preconfigured, factory-tested 20V4000 L64 modules deliver plants from 5 MW to several hundred MW, hydrogen-ready and biomethane capable, for utilities, data centres and industry. Rolls-Royce cites 17 GW plus of installed gas capacity and 500 mtu gas gensets in the UK.
gas-dual-fuel-gensets.compNote: Where Cummins Arabia stands in this area: Cummins fields HSK78G (C2000N5CD, C2000N6CD) and QSK60G and supplies gas sets to the Circe Energy Texas data centre microgrid, but mtu's fast-start 20V4000 GS and Caterpillar's G3520K and CG260 have deeper Gulf gas references and Rehlko's INNIO framework is 1.25 GW even if it does not reach the Gulf.

gas-dual-fuel-gensets.t: Fast-start mtu 20V4000 gas gensets for data centre prime and backup power, 45 second start from 2026
gas-dual-fuel-gensets.body: Rolls-Royce launched a 2.8 MW 20V4000 L64 gas genset with 10% better efficiency, 120 second start today and a 45 second start 60 Hz model from 2026, aimed at data centres waiting for grid connections. Existing gas genset fleets cited in the UK (500 plus), Canada and Jakarta.
gas-dual-fuel-gensets.impact: [Analysis] No visible Cummins Arabia answer yet. This targets the same grid-constrained data centre prime power need that Cummins addresses with the HSK78G and QSK95 gas sets, and the 60 Hz variant is built for markets like Saudi Arabia. In UAE and KSA data centre campuses where gas is available, mtu can now bid diesel backup, gas prime and dynamic UPS as one package. Cummins Arabia should lead with HSK78G efficiency and Cummins' Gulf gas service record before mtu's 60 Hz set ships.

gas-dual-fuel-gensets.t: Baudouin platinum sponsor at Middle East Energy 2025: 20M61 genset (6,250 kVA) pre-launch, 6M31 Stage V PowerKit, 20M55 gas genset
gas-dual-fuel-gensets.body: At Dubai World Trade Centre (stand S3.B40 and outdoor OS.90), Baudouin revealed the 20M61 data centre genset up to 6,250 kVA, launched the 6M31 Stage V-ready PowerKit and showed a 20M55 gas genset up to 5,250 kVA, 12M33 plus SCR Stage V and 6M16 Stage V. CEO Fabrizio Mozzi called it the largest genset available for critical backup power. Baudouin claimed best lead times in the market.
gas-dual-fuel-gensets.impact: [Analysis] No visible Cummins Arabia answer yet. A 6,250 kVA single unit outranks Cummins' largest diesel node and is aimed at hyperscale campuses in the UAE and KSA. Cummins Arabia's counter is the installed base, Cummins factory paralleling and controls, service depth and proven 50 degree C performance. It should also test Baudouin's lead-time claims against real Cummins slot availability when quoting.

gas-dual-fuel-gensets.t: Volvo Penta introduces G17 natural gas engine for power generation, aimed at data centres and utilities
gas-dual-fuel-gensets.body: First Volvo Penta natural gas genset engine, framed as lower-emission, scalable backup power for data centres, utilities and mission-critical infrastructure.
gas-dual-fuel-gensets.impact: [Analysis] Cummins Arabia has an answer. Adds a gas option at the 17 litre node for packagers. In the Gulf the relevant overlap is with Cummins gas gensets in the 400 to 700 kW band for oil and gas and utility sites in KSA and Kuwait.

gas-dual-fuel-gensets.compNote: Where Cummins Arabia stands in this area: Cummins fields HSK78G (C2000N5CD, C2000N6CD) and QSK60G and supplies gas sets to the Circe Energy Texas data centre microgrid, but mtu's fast-start 20V4000 GS and Caterpillar's G3520K and CG260 have deeper Gulf gas references and Rehlko's INNIO framework is 1.25 GW even if it does not reach the Gulf.

gas-dual-fuel-gensets.t: Cummins to supply HSK78G and QSK60 gas gensets for Circe Energy HPC data centres in West Texas
gas-dual-fuel-gensets.body: Behind-the-meter prime power natural gas microgrids for AI and HPC data centres using HSK78G (C2000N6CD) and QSK60 (C1400N6) gensets, deliveries 2026 to 2030 with modular deployment from 2027.
gas-dual-fuel-gensets.impact: [Analysis] Cummins Arabia's own position. Gas prime power for data centres is now a Cummins reference model. In KSA and the UAE, where pipeline gas is available at industrial sites, Cummins Arabia can propose HSK78G prime power or bridging power for data centre and industrial loads waiting on grid connections.
gas-dual-fuel-gensets.whatsNew: Behind-the-meter prime power natural gas microgrids for AI and HPC data centres using HSK78G (C2000N6CD) and QSK60 (C1400N6) gensets, deliveries 2026 to 2030 with modular deployment from 2027.
gas-dual-fuel-gensets.compNote: Gas prime power for data centres is now a Cummins reference model. In KSA and the UAE, where pipeline gas is available at industrial sites, Cummins Arabia can propose HSK78G prime power or bridging power for data centre and industrial loads waiting on grid connections.

gas-dual-fuel-gensets.t: HSK78G certified for hydraulic fracturing (EPA Tier 2 mobile off-highway)
gas-dual-fuel-gensets.body: The 78 litre, 12 cylinder HSK78G natural gas engine, rated 3000 bhp, received EPA Tier 2 large spark-ignition mobile off-highway certification for well servicing, joining the Spark-Ignited Pumping Power portfolio.
gas-dual-fuel-gensets.impact: [Analysis] Cummins Arabia's own position. Relevant to Cummins Arabia's oil and gas engine business as Saudi unconventional gas programmes expand; also confirms the HSK78G platform's power density that underpins the C2000N gas genset range offered in the Gulf.
gas-dual-fuel-gensets.whatsNew: The 78 litre, 12 cylinder HSK78G natural gas engine, rated 3000 bhp, received EPA Tier 2 large spark-ignition mobile off-highway certification for well servicing, joining the Spark-Ignited Pumping Power portfolio.
gas-dual-fuel-gensets.compNote: Relevant to Cummins Arabia's oil and gas engine business as Saudi unconventional gas programmes expand; also confirms the HSK78G platform's power density that underpins the C2000N gas genset range offered in the Gulf.

hydrogen-hydrogen-blend-engines.t: MHIET sets hydrogen co-firing specifications for KU series gas engines (3.65 to 5.75 MW)
hydrogen-hydrogen-blend-engines.body: Up to 50% hydrogen by volume on 18KU30SI class engines for cogeneration, grid stability and power wheeling, available for new units and retrofits with minimal design change.
hydrogen-hydrogen-blend-engines.impact: [Analysis] No visible Cummins Arabia answer yet. KU series competes with Cummins HSK78G and larger gas engines in industrial CHP and grid support. Gulf gas engine demand from data centres and utilities is growing and Mitsubishi now has a hydrogen-ready spec to offer. Cummins Arabia should sharpen its own fuel flexibility story.
hydrogen-hydrogen-blend-engines.whatsNew: Up to 50% hydrogen by volume on 18KU30SI class engines for cogeneration, grid stability and power wheeling, available for new units and retrofits with minimal design change.
hydrogen-hydrogen-blend-engines.compNote: Where Cummins Arabia stands in this area: Cummins sold its low-pressure fuel cell business in Q1 2026 citing lower hydrogen adoption; Accelera electrolysers remain. mtu markets hydrogen-ready Series 4000 and Caterpillar demonstrates hydrogen gensets; NEOM's green hydrogen programme keeps the topic alive in Saudi tenders.

hydrogen-hydrogen-blend-engines.t: MHIET 500 kW class 100% hydrogen engine generator set reaches commercial readiness level
hydrogen-hydrogen-blend-engines.body: 435 kWe at 1,500 rpm from a 6-cylinder 170 mm bore engine on pure hydrogen, tested at Sagamihara with green hydrogen; only long-term durability evaluation remains.
hydrogen-hydrogen-blend-engines.impact: [Analysis] No visible Cummins Arabia answer yet. Relevant to NEOM and UAE hydrogen showcase projects where zero carbon backup power will be specified. Cummins Arabia should be ready to discuss Cummins hydrogen engine roadmap when consultants raise this.
hydrogen-hydrogen-blend-engines.whatsNew: 435 kWe at 1,500 rpm from a 6-cylinder 170 mm bore engine on pure hydrogen, tested at Sagamihara with green hydrogen; only long-term durability evaluation remains.
hydrogen-hydrogen-blend-engines.compNote: Where Cummins Arabia stands in this area: Cummins sold its low-pressure fuel cell business in Q1 2026 citing lower hydrogen adoption; Accelera electrolysers remain. mtu markets hydrogen-ready Series 4000 and Caterpillar demonstrates hydrogen gensets; NEOM's green hydrogen programme keeps the topic alive in Saudi tenders.

hydrogen-hydrogen-blend-engines.t: Perkins shows 2600 Series, hydrogen hybrid IOPU and battery-electric power unit at CONEXPO 2026
hydrogen-hydrogen-blend-engines.body: Perkins announced the 904J-E36TTA (129 kW), the 13 litre 2600 Series (340 to 515 kW, Stage V and Tier 4 Final), Project Coeus hydrogen hybrid IOPU (379 kW combined) and a 95.5 kW battery-electric power unit. Richard Hemmings, VP and GM Global Sales, Marketing, Service and Parts, framed the message as lower total cost of ownership and future fuel readiness.
hydrogen-hydrogen-blend-engines.impact: [Analysis] No visible Cummins Arabia answer yet. Hybrid and alternative fuel work is still at prototype stage for Perkins and is aimed at off-highway more than gensets. The relevant signal is the Stage V 2600 Series, which packagers can pair with Gulf tenders that start asking for Stage V or Tier 4 Final in urban and data centre sites. Cummins Arabia should keep its own Stage V and Tier 4 Final genset offer visible to consultants in UAE and KSA.

Richard Hemmings, VP and GM Global Sales, Marketing, Service and Parts, framed the message as lower total cost of ownership and future fuel readiness.

hydrogen-hydrogen-blend-engines.t: MHIET launches 450 kW gas cogeneration system capable of hydrogen co-firing
hydrogen-hydrogen-blend-engines.body: Reliability verified through demonstration testing; part of MHIET's low carbon gas engine roadmap.
hydrogen-hydrogen-blend-engines.impact: [Analysis] No visible Cummins Arabia answer yet. Small gas CHP is a Japan-first product. Gulf relevance is limited today but it signals Mitsubishi will pitch hydrogen-ready gas engines into Saudi and UAE decarbonisation programmes where Cummins gas gensets also compete.
hydrogen-hydrogen-blend-engines.whatsNew: Reliability verified through demonstration testing; part of MHIET's low carbon gas engine roadmap.

alternative-renewable-fuel-flexibility.t: FG Wilson gensets pass HVO field trials with Tria Energy
alternative-renewable-fuel-flexibility.body: FG Wilson Engineering (Dublin) Ltd and Tria Energy reported diesel-equivalent performance on HVO (EN 15940) across load conditions with no engine or fuel system changes, up to 90 percent lifecycle CO2 savings, aimed at data centre, construction and critical infrastructure customers.
alternative-renewable-fuel-flexibility.impact: [Analysis] Cummins Arabia has an answer. HVO acceptance is becoming a standard question in data centre tenders in the UAE. FG Wilson now has published trial evidence to cite. Cummins Arabia should have equivalent HVO approval statements for its data centre range ready in tender documents.
alternative-renewable-fuel-flexibility.whatsNew: FG Wilson Engineering (Dublin) Ltd and Tria Energy reported diesel-equivalent performance on HVO (EN 15940) across load conditions with no engine or fuel system changes, up to 90 percent lifecycle CO2 savings, aimed at data centre, construction and critical infrastructure customers.
alternative-renewable-fuel-flexibility.compNote: Where Cummins Arabia stands in this area: Zahid supplied B100-capable Cat sets to Red Sea Global; mtu published EPDs and an HVO paper with Microsoft; Cummins approves HVO across the QSK range but has no Gulf-specific renewable fuel reference.

alternative-renewable-fuel-flexibility.t: First emergency gensets with verified Environmental Product Declarations: 16V4000 DS2500 and 10V1600
alternative-renewable-fuel-flexibility.body: Rolls-Royce delivered the first data centre gensets carrying externally verified EPDs published via Environdec to a European operator, positioning EPDs as a new transparency standard for critical power.
alternative-renewable-fuel-flexibility.impact: [Analysis] Cummins Arabia has an answer. EPDs will be asked for by hyperscalers and by UAE and Saudi green building schemes. If a UAE data centre RFP requires EPDs, Cummins Arabia needs Cummins' equivalent documentation ready or it loses on a compliance line rather than on price.
alternative-renewable-fuel-flexibility.whatsNew: Rolls-Royce delivered the first data centre gensets carrying externally verified EPDs published via Environdec to a European operator, positioning EPDs as a new transparency standard for critical power.
alternative-renewable-fuel-flexibility.compNote: Where Cummins Arabia stands in this area: Zahid supplied B100-capable Cat sets to Red Sea Global; mtu published EPDs and an HVO paper with Microsoft; Cummins approves HVO across the QSK range but has no Gulf-specific renewable fuel reference.

electronic-engine-controls-ecu.t: Rehlko introduces next-generation APM804 control platform
electronic-engine-controls-ecu.body: New controller aimed at the complexity, scale and resilience requirements of modern data centres; APM804 now appears as a standard controller option on KD spec sheets.
electronic-engine-controls-ecu.impact: [Analysis] Cummins Arabia has an answer. Controls and paralleling are a decision factor for data centre consultants. Cummins Arabia should ensure PowerCommand paralleling and monitoring capabilities are presented head to head with APM804 in consultant briefings.
electronic-engine-controls-ecu.whatsNew: New controller aimed at the complexity, scale and resilience requirements of modern data centres; APM804 now appears as a standard controller option on KD spec sheets.
electronic-engine-controls-ecu.compNote: Where Cummins Arabia stands in this area: Cummins PowerCommand and the DMC family (the Riyadh telecom MC-150 to DMC6000 retrofit is a live reference) compete with Cat EMCP 4 and ECS, Rehlko APM804 and Cholet switchgear, and DSE controllers on FG Wilson and Baudouin sets.

electronic-engine-controls-ecu.t: FG Wilson lists new 'M' variants across the large range (P1100-1M to P2500-3M) with DSE7410 control
electronic-engine-controls-ecu.body: FG Wilson's large range pages now pair each legacy model with an M variant (P1100-1M, P1650-1M, P2250-3M, P2500-3M), all on Perkins 4008, 4012 and 4016 engines, FG Wilson alternators with AREP excitation and Deep Sea 7410 controllers, with new datasheets dated 2024-10 and 2026-03.
electronic-engine-controls-ecu.impact: [Analysis] Cummins Arabia has an answer. FG Wilson's top end remains 2,500 kVA on the mechanical 4016-61TRG3 while the electronic 5016 is sold to other packagers. Cummins Arabia's C2500 to C3500 range and its factory data centre ratings remain a differentiator above 2,500 kVA and in DCC rated applications. Below 2,500 kVA expect the refreshed FG Wilson range to be pushed hard by TAMGO and FG Wilson FZE.

electronic-engine-controls-ecu.t: Rehlko invests EUR 12 million to expand Cholet, France switchgear plant
electronic-engine-controls-ecu.body: 56% expansion of manufacturing space over five years, 30% lead time reduction on completion in November 2026, over 100 new jobs; Cholet builds LV main switchboards, generator switchboards and control panels for data centre solutions.
electronic-engine-controls-ecu.impact: [Analysis] Cummins Arabia has an answer. Rehlko is shortening lead times on the paralleling switchgear that ships with large genset packages to EMEA including the Gulf. Cummins Arabia should quantify its own switchgear lead times and partner capacity so it is not outpaced on complete package delivery.
electronic-engine-controls-ecu.whatsNew: 56% expansion of manufacturing space over five years, 30% lead time reduction on completion in November 2026, over 100 new jobs; Cholet builds LV main switchboards, generator switchboards and control panels for data centre solutions.

electronic-engine-controls-ecu.t: Cummins Arabia completes DMC6000 master controller retrofit for a Riyadh telecom operator
electronic-engine-controls-ecu.body: Three 800 kW QSK23-G3 gensets at a major network and communication service provider in Riyadh moved from a 20 year old MC-150 master controller to a PowerCommand DMC6000 with PCC3300 upgrades, completed in a six week shutdown window under Cummins Arabia supervision.
electronic-engine-controls-ecu.impact: [Analysis] Cummins Arabia's own position. Installed-base modernisation is a repeatable revenue line in KSA telecom and data centre sites running legacy PowerCommand controls. Cummins Arabia can package DMC6000 retrofits with service contracts as a defensive move against competitor replacement offers.
electronic-engine-controls-ecu.whatsNew: Three 800 kW QSK23-G3 gensets at a major network and communication service provider in Riyadh moved from a 20 year old MC-150 master controller to a PowerCommand DMC6000 with PCC3300 upgrades, completed in a six week shutdown window under Cummins Arabia supervision.

emissions-compliance-aftertreatment.t: Volvo Penta publishes data centre backup power positioning: Tier 4 Final platform, modular approach, independent partner to OEMs and system integrators
emissions-compliance-aftertreatment.body: Volvo Penta states it collaborates with OEMs and system integrators on flexible data centre backup power, cites automotive-scale production for shorter lead times, stackable modular configurations and HVO100 compatibility for all engines built since 2016.
emissions-compliance-aftertreatment.impact: [Analysis] Cummins Arabia has an answer. Volvo's data centre pitch is modular many-small-units, which fits edge and enterprise sites rather than the hyperscale campuses driving Gulf demand. Cummins Arabia should watch packager bids on edge data centres in UAE.
emissions-compliance-aftertreatment.whatsNew: Volvo Penta states it collaborates with OEMs and system integrators on flexible data centre backup power, cites automotive-scale production for shorter lead times, stackable modular configurations and HVO100 compatibility for all engines built since 2016.
emissions-compliance-aftertreatment.compNote: Where Cummins Arabia stands in this area: Most Gulf tenders accept Tier 2; UAE and NEOM sites increasingly ask for Tier 4 or Stage V. mtu publishes Tier 4 60 Hz sheets, Cat offers 3516E Tier 4 packages, Cummins has Tier 2 and Tier 4 variants across the QSK range.

hybrid-diesel-battery-bess.t: Volvo Penta positions itself as total power solutions provider for the digital infrastructure market at CONEXPO 2026
hybrid-diesel-battery-bess.body: Volvo Penta announced it would show D8 Stage V/Tier 4 Final, BESS, electric driveline and its energy transition roadmap, and referenced BESS wins with KJ Power (Turkey), Aura Clean Energy and SEETEL.
hybrid-diesel-battery-bess.impact: [Analysis] Cummins Arabia has an answer. KJ Power is a Turkish packager active in Gulf tenders; Volvo BESS subsystems inside packager products would compete with Cummins BESS in rental and hybrid applications.
hybrid-diesel-battery-bess.whatsNew: Volvo Penta announced it would show D8 Stage V/Tier 4 Final, BESS, electric driveline and its energy transition roadmap, and referenced BESS wins with KJ Power (Turkey), Aura Clean Energy and SEETEL.
hybrid-diesel-battery-bess.compNote: Where Cummins Arabia stands in this area: Cummins Arabia launched factory BESS in Dubai in April 2025 (C200B5ZE to C2000B5ZE, LFP) and commissioned the first EMEIA unit at Al Quoz; Caterpillar Energy Storage and mtu EnergyPack are the rival lines, Rehlko has no Gulf storage offer.

hybrid-diesel-battery-bess.t: Cummins launches containerised BESS in the UAE through Cummins Arabia
hybrid-diesel-battery-bess.body: Cummins Power Generation, Cummins Arabia and Cummins Middle East launched the LFP battery energy storage range in Dubai, with Amit Deshpande (Managing Director) and Emad Lotfy (Power Generation Business Director) quoted. Cummins Arabia was described as 550 plus staff, 10 service branches, 8 warehouses, an HHP Master Rebuild Center and a training centre across UAE, KSA and Kuwait.
hybrid-diesel-battery-bess.impact: [Analysis] Cummins Arabia's own position. Gives Cummins Arabia a hybrid genset plus storage offer for rental, data centre and oil and gas customers before most genset competitors in the Gulf have a factory-branded BESS with genset controller integration. The 50 Hz only listing means KSA 60 Hz sites need confirmation of a 60 Hz variant.
hybrid-diesel-battery-bess.whatsNew: Cummins Power Generation, Cummins Arabia and Cummins Middle East launched the LFP battery energy storage range in Dubai, with Amit Deshpande (Managing Director) and Emad Lotfy (Power Generation Business Director) quoted. Cummins Arabia was described as 550 plus staff, 10 service branches, 8 warehouses, an HHP Master Rebuild Center and a training centre across UAE, KSA and Kuwait.

The 50 Hz only listing means KSA 60 Hz sites need confirmation of a 60 Hz variant.

hybrid-diesel-battery-bess.t: First Cummins BESS in EMEIA commissioned at Cummins Arabia Al Quoz, Dubai
hybrid-diesel-battery-bess.body: A C400B5ZE (422 kWh / 200 kW) was commissioned in Q3 2025 at Cummins Arabia's Al Quoz facility for peak shaving alongside containerised diesel gensets; Q4 2025 results were 12.7 MWh discharged, 382 generator hours and 5,443.5 litres of diesel avoided.
hybrid-diesel-battery-bess.impact: [Analysis] Cummins Arabia's own position. A live, metered hybrid reference on Cummins Arabia's own site is the demonstration asset for rental fleets, remote oil and gas camps and construction sites in the UAE and KSA. The measured fuel and runtime savings give the sales team quantified payback material.

hybrid-diesel-battery-bess.t: Cummins wins 5 MWh BESS supply for a large US data centre
hybrid-diesel-battery-bess.body: Cummins selected to supply LFP battery energy storage systems with 5 MWh nominal capacity for a large US data centre project, its largest BESS deployment to date, to manage AI-driven load fluctuations and support utility interconnection requirements.
hybrid-diesel-battery-bess.impact: [Analysis] Cummins Arabia's own position. Validates BESS as a data centre product line, not only a remote-power line. Cummins Arabia can bundle BESS with genset blocks in KSA and UAE data centre proposals to address load-following and interconnection ramp requirements.
hybrid-diesel-battery-bess.whatsNew: Cummins selected to supply LFP battery energy storage systems with 5 MWh nominal capacity for a large US data centre project, its largest BESS deployment to date, to manage AI-driven load fluctuations and support utility interconnection requirements.
hybrid-diesel-battery-bess.compNote: Validates BESS as a data centre product line, not only a remote-power line. Cummins Arabia can bundle BESS with genset blocks in KSA and UAE data centre proposals to address load-following and interconnection ramp requirements.

compact-design-power-density.t: Caterpillar launches Cat D1500 1.5 MW compact diesel genset on C32B engine
compact-design-power-density.body: New D1500 60 Hz standby genset on the 32.1 litre C32B, up to 13% less floor space and 32% lighter than the previous 1.5 MW node, EPA Tier 2 stationary emergency, targeted at North America first.
compact-design-power-density.impact: [Analysis] Cummins Arabia has an answer. A 1.5 MW node on a 32 litre engine attacks the footprint and weight argument in the 1,500 to 1,875 kVA class where Cummins sells QSK50 based sets in Saudi 60 Hz projects. Watch for a 50 Hz and Middle East release; until then it is a North America product.
compact-design-power-density.whatsNew: New D1500 60 Hz standby genset on the 32.1 litre C32B, up to 13% less floor space and 32% lighter than the previous 1.5 MW node, EPA Tier 2 stationary emergency, targeted at North America first.
compact-design-power-density.compNote: Where Cummins Arabia stands in this area: The S17 Centum (C800D6E) and the 95 litre QSK95 sets are Cummins' density play; mtu Series 4000 and Cat 3516E are the benchmarks the spec pairs measure against.

compact-design-power-density.t: Volvo Penta adds D13 power node TAD1346GE 500 kVA
compact-design-power-density.body: New D13 rating described as reliable, compact and fuel-efficient addition to the power offer.
compact-design-power-density.impact: [Analysis] Cummins Arabia has an answer. 500 kVA is the most contested packager node in the Gulf commercial market; a D13 at 500 kVA competes with Cummins QSX15 based sets on price through packagers.
compact-design-power-density.whatsNew: New D13 rating described as reliable, compact and fuel-efficient addition to the power offer.
compact-design-power-density.compNote: Where Cummins Arabia stands in this area: The S17 Centum (C800D6E) and the 95 litre QSK95 sets are Cummins' density play; mtu Series 4000 and Cat 3516E are the benchmarks the spec pairs measure against.

compact-design-power-density.t: Cummins announces S17 Centum 17 litre genset up to 1000 kW
compact-design-power-density.body: New S17 engine based Centum Series (C600D6E to C1000D6ED, 60 Hz, EPA Tier 2 stationary emergency) with 25,000 plus hours of validation and a three year base warranty, aimed at commercial, healthcare and water treatment standby.
compact-design-power-density.impact: [Analysis] Cummins Arabia's own position. A 1 MW class set on a 17 L block cuts footprint and fuel against 23 L to 30 L competitors in the 600 to 1000 kW band that dominates KSA hospital, commercial and telecom tenders. Cummins Arabia should confirm 60 Hz availability for Africa Middle East and price it against Cat C18 and mtu 12V1600 class units.
compact-design-power-density.whatsNew: New S17 engine based Centum Series (C600D6E to C1000D6ED, 60 Hz, EPA Tier 2 stationary emergency) with 25,000 plus hours of validation and a three year base warranty, aimed at commercial, healthcare and water treatment standby.
compact-design-power-density.compNote: A 1 MW class set on a 17 L block cuts footprint and fuel against 23 L to 30 L competitors in the 600 to 1000 kW band that dominates KSA hospital, commercial and telecom tenders. Cummins Arabia should confirm 60 Hz availability for Africa Middle East and price it against Cat C18 and mtu 12V1600 class units.

hydrogen-hydrogen-blend-engines.desc: Hydrogen ready engines, hydrogen blend gensets, electrolysers and fuel cells.
hydrogen-hydrogen-blend-engines.reason: Cummins sold its low-pressure fuel cell business in Q1 2026 citing lower hydrogen adoption; Accelera electrolysers remain. mtu markets hydrogen-ready Series 4000 and Caterpillar demonstrates hydrogen gensets; NEOM's green hydrogen programme keeps the topic alive in Saudi tenders.
hydrogen-hydrogen-blend-engines.why: Hydrogen is a tender checkbox more than a volume market in the Gulf today. Being unable to tick it costs points in NEOM and Aramco evaluations even when the diesel set wins on merit.

hybrid-diesel-battery-bess.desc: Battery energy storage systems and genset plus battery hybrids for peak shaving, instant backup and renewable integration.
hybrid-diesel-battery-bess.reason: Cummins Arabia launched factory BESS in Dubai in April 2025 (C200B5ZE to C2000B5ZE, LFP) and commissioned the first EMEIA unit at Al Quoz; Caterpillar Energy Storage and mtu EnergyPack are the rival lines, Rehlko has no Gulf storage offer.
hybrid-diesel-battery-bess.why: BESS turns the genset from a standby asset into a dispatchable one and is the entry ticket for utility and microgrid tenders in NEOM, Red Sea and the Kuwait rebuild.

gas-dual-fuel-gensets.desc: Natural gas and dual-fuel gensets for prime and behind-the-meter power, including fast-start gas sets for mission-critical standby and modular gas plants where grid connections lag.
gas-dual-fuel-gensets.reason: Cummins fields HSK78G (C2000N5CD, C2000N6CD) and QSK60G and supplies gas sets to the Circe Energy Texas data centre microgrid, but mtu's fast-start 20V4000 GS and Caterpillar's G3520K and CG260 have deeper Gulf gas references and Rehlko's INNIO framework is 1.25 GW even if it does not reach the Gulf.
gas-dual-fuel-gensets.why: Gulf gas is cheap and grid connections are the binding constraint for AI campuses. Gas prime power is the credible alternative to waiting for a substation, so it competes with diesel standby for the same budget.

alternative-renewable-fuel-flexibility.desc: HVO and biodiesel approvals, environmental product declarations and fuel-flexible ratings that let a diesel set claim lower lifecycle emissions.
alternative-renewable-fuel-flexibility.reason: Zahid supplied B100-capable Cat sets to Red Sea Global; mtu published EPDs and an HVO paper with Microsoft; Cummins approves HVO across the QSK range but has no Gulf-specific renewable fuel reference.
alternative-renewable-fuel-flexibility.why: Giga-project developers score ESG in evaluations. A renewable fuel approval and an EPD are low-cost qualifications that decide ties.

compact-design-power-density.desc: Power density and footprint: more kW per square metre for urban and space-constrained data halls.
compact-design-power-density.reason: The S17 Centum (C800D6E) and the 95 litre QSK95 sets are Cummins' density play; mtu Series 4000 and Cat 3516E are the benchmarks the spec pairs measure against.
compact-design-power-density.why: Data hall footprint is priced per square metre in Riyadh and Dubai; density is a direct cost argument.

electronic-engine-controls-ecu.desc: Genset controllers, paralleling switchgear and digital master controls.
electronic-engine-controls-ecu.reason: Cummins PowerCommand and the DMC family (the Riyadh telecom MC-150 to DMC6000 retrofit is a live reference) compete with Cat EMCP 4 and ECS, Rehlko APM804 and Cholet switchgear, and DSE controllers on FG Wilson and Baudouin sets.
electronic-engine-controls-ecu.why: Controls decide the retrofit and service annuity on the installed base, which is the most defensible revenue Cummins Arabia has.

manufacturing-capacity-localisation.desc: Large-engine factory capacity, regional assembly and Saudi content: who can deliver in 2026 to 2027 and who can claim localization under Vision 2030.
manufacturing-capacity-localisation.reason: Cummins is adding high-horsepower capacity through 2030 but has no Saudi assembly; mtu's Makeen JV holds a Saudi manufacturing licence, Mitsubishi Power assembles in Dammam, FG Wilson assembles in Jebel Ali, Jubaili Bros manufactures in KSA, and Rehlko and Weichai are doubling Chinese output aimed at EMEA.
manufacturing-capacity-localisation.why: Delivery slots and local content are the two questions every Gulf buyer asks first in 2026. Rivals have answers on at least one of them.

emissions-compliance-aftertreatment.desc: Emission tiers and aftertreatment: Tier 2 stationary emergency, Tier 4 Final and Stage V sets for regulated sites.
emissions-compliance-aftertreatment.reason: Most Gulf tenders accept Tier 2; UAE and NEOM sites increasingly ask for Tier 4 or Stage V. mtu publishes Tier 4 60 Hz sheets, Cat offers 3516E Tier 4 packages, Cummins has Tier 2 and Tier 4 variants across the QSK range.
emissions-compliance-aftertreatment.why: Emission tier is a gate in UAE and giga-project tenders even when it is not enforced nationally.

high-ambient-thermal-management.desc: Ratings and cooling packages for 50 to 55 C ambient, the defining Gulf requirement.
high-ambient-thermal-management.reason: mtu rated the Kuwait Airport T2 sets at 55 C; Cummins engineered the Saudi hyperscale sets for 50 C ambient; Cat dealer listings quote 50 C standard. The published derate tables decide summer output claims.
high-ambient-thermal-management.why: A 50 C rating on the datasheet is the difference between a bid that passes the consultant review and one that needs a derate letter.

data-centre-continuous-prime-power.desc: Backup and continuous rated gensets for hyperscale and colocation data centres: Uptime Tier III and IV compliance, DCC ratings, 13.8 kV medium voltage sets, 50 C ambient packages, and multi-GW hyperscaler frameworks that pre-book factory output.
data-centre-continuous-prime-power.reason: Cummins holds the 73.2 MW Saudi hyperscale reference (30 DQLC + 6 DQCA) and the Centum range (S17 Centum, QSK78 and QSK95 based C2750D6E to C3500D6E) with DCC ratings, but Caterpillar 3516E and C175, mtu Series 4000, Rehlko KD and Baudouin M55 all publish competing data centre cards and several have signed multi-GW frameworks that consume capacity through 2027.
data-centre-continuous-prime-power.why: This is where the Gulf genset volume of 2027 to 2030 sits: HUMAIN, DataVolt, Khazna, Microsoft and AWS plots specified in 2,500 to 3,500 kVA blocks. Whoever is qualified with the design consultants and can show delivery slots wins the plot.

patterns.implication: Fuel burn decides lifecycle cost in a 50 C standby fleet. A model with no published figure cannot be scored and should be treated as unproven in a bid.

strat.thesis: Caterpillar is the incumbent spec in Gulf data centres, giga-projects and Aramco sites, sold through Zahid Tractor (22 to 24 Saudi branches, dealer since 1950) and Al-Bahar (UAE, Kuwait). Altaaqa's 1 GW Cat rental fleet absorbs outage-driven demand before any sale is tendered. Cat's large-engine capacity is being consumed by US AI builds through 2027, so delivery slots in the Gulf are the field where Cummins Arabia can move.

profile.legal_name: Cummins Arabia (Cummins Saudi Arabia Limited, Cummins Arabia FZCO, Cummins Kuwait); 50:50 JV of Cummins Inc. and The Olayan Group
profile.employees: Over 550 professionals (Cummins press release, April 2025); close to 500 employees of 30 plus nationalities at launch (June 2017)
profile.revenue: Cummins Arabia revenue not published. Parent Cummins Inc. FY2025 revenue USD 33.7 billion, net income USD 2.8 billion; Power Systems segment sales USD 7.463 billion (investor.cummins.com, 2026-02-05)
profile.industry: Distribution, sales and service of Cummins diesel and gas generator sets (2.5 kW to 3500 kW), engines, filtration, parts, BESS and HHP rebuild in Saudi Arabia, UAE and Kuwait
profile.positioning: Cummins Arabia is the exclusive Cummins distribution and service JV for Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Kuwait, formed in 2017 by Cummins Inc. and Olayan, whose Cummins distribution history in Saudi Arabia dates to 1956. It runs 10 service branches, 8 warehouses, an HHP Master Rebuild Center and a service training centre with 550 plus staff. Its competitive position in Gulf power generation rests on the Cummins HHP range (QSK60, QSK78, QSK95 and the new Centum Series) for 60 Hz Saudi and 50 Hz UAE and Kuwait data centres, the PowerCommand controls and DMC paralleling family, and the 2025 addition of factory BESS. The 73.2 MW Saudi hyperscale delivery and the first EMEIA BESS commissioning in Dubai are its current reference points
