moves.headline: Cummins Arabia completes DMC6000 master controller retrofit for a Riyadh telecom operator
moves.summary: Three 800 kW QSK23-G3 gensets at a major network and communication service provider in Riyadh moved from a 20 year old MC-150 master controller to a PowerCommand DMC6000 with PCC3300 upgrades, completed in a six week shutdown window under Cummins Arabia supervision.
moves.analysis: Installed-base modernisation is a repeatable revenue line in KSA telecom and data centre sites running legacy PowerCommand controls. Cummins Arabia can package DMC6000 retrofits with service contracts as a defensive move against competitor replacement offers.

moves.headline: Cummins launches containerised BESS in the UAE through Cummins Arabia
moves.summary: Cummins Power Generation, Cummins Arabia and Cummins Middle East launched the LFP battery energy storage range in Dubai, with Amit Deshpande (Managing Director) and Emad Lotfy (Power Generation Business Director) quoted. Cummins Arabia was described as 550 plus staff, 10 service branches, 8 warehouses, an HHP Master Rebuild Center and a training centre across UAE, KSA and Kuwait.
moves.analysis: Gives Cummins Arabia a hybrid genset plus storage offer for rental, data centre and oil and gas customers before most genset competitors in the Gulf have a factory-branded BESS with genset controller integration. The 50 Hz only listing means KSA 60 Hz sites need confirmation of a 60 Hz variant.

moves.headline: Cummins Arabia publishes 73.2 MW Saudi hyperscale data centre reference
moves.summary: Thirty DQLC and six DQCA enclosed gensets (36 units, 73.2 MW) were delivered in seven months to a regional technology provider's hyperscale sites across Saudi Arabia, engineered for 50 C ambient with remote radiators, dual ACB panels, Ni-Cad batteries and fuel coolers, tested to Uptime Institute requirements.
moves.analysis: This is the proof point for 60 Hz QSK78 supply into KSA hyperscale programmes. The case study states the customer recommended Cummins Arabia for future phases, so follow-on capacity should be protected with reserved production slots given Cummins Inc reports record data centre order books.

moves.headline: Cummins announces S17 Centum 17 litre genset up to 1000 kW
moves.summary: New S17 engine based Centum Series (C600D6E to C1000D6ED, 60 Hz, EPA Tier 2 stationary emergency) with 25,000 plus hours of validation and a three year base warranty, aimed at commercial, healthcare and water treatment standby.
moves.analysis: A 1 MW class set on a 17 L block cuts footprint and fuel against 23 L to 30 L competitors in the 600 to 1000 kW band that dominates KSA hospital, commercial and telecom tenders. Cummins Arabia should confirm 60 Hz availability for Africa Middle East and price it against Cat C18 and mtu 12V1600 class units.

moves.headline: Cummins reports FY2025 revenue of USD 33.7 billion; Power Systems sales USD 7.46 billion
moves.summary: Full year 2025 revenue USD 33.7 billion (down 1 percent), net income USD 2.8 billion, EBITDA USD 5.4 billion. Power Systems segment sales USD 7.463 billion with EBITDA USD 1.694 billion (22.7 percent); Q4 Power Systems sales up 11 percent on data centre demand in North America, China and Asia Pacific.
moves.analysis: Power Systems is the growth engine of the parent, but the cited demand regions do not include the Middle East. Cummins Arabia competes internally for HHP allocation; documented Gulf pipeline visibility is what secures slots against North American and Asian data centre orders.

moves.headline: First Cummins BESS in EMEIA commissioned at Cummins Arabia Al Quoz, Dubai
moves.summary: A C400B5ZE (422 kWh / 200 kW) was commissioned in Q3 2025 at Cummins Arabia's Al Quoz facility for peak shaving alongside containerised diesel gensets; Q4 2025 results were 12.7 MWh discharged, 382 generator hours and 5,443.5 litres of diesel avoided.
moves.analysis: A live, metered hybrid reference on Cummins Arabia's own site is the demonstration asset for rental fleets, remote oil and gas camps and construction sites in the UAE and KSA. The measured fuel and runtime savings give the sales team quantified payback material.

moves.headline: Cummins raises 2030 targets and announces large-engine capacity and product investments at Analyst Day
moves.summary: At its 2026 Analyst Day Cummins raised 2030 financial targets and announced further capacity and product investments to strengthen positioning in mining and power generation; Power Systems President Jenny Bush said demand for reliable power is accelerating at an unprecedented pace. Dollar and GW figures are in the presentation, not the release.
moves.analysis: Added HHP capacity is the constraint that decides whether Cummins Arabia can bid multi-hundred megawatt KSA data centre phases on schedule. Cummins Arabia should lock forward allocation agreements for QSK78 and QSK95 sets while capacity ramps.

moves.headline: Cummins to supply HSK78G and QSK60 gas gensets for Circe Energy HPC data centres in West Texas
moves.summary: Behind-the-meter prime power natural gas microgrids for AI and HPC data centres using HSK78G (C2000N6CD) and QSK60 (C1400N6) gensets, deliveries 2026 to 2030 with modular deployment from 2027.
moves.analysis: Gas prime power for data centres is now a Cummins reference model. In KSA and the UAE, where pipeline gas is available at industrial sites, Cummins Arabia can propose HSK78G prime power or bridging power for data centre and industrial loads waiting on grid connections.

moves.headline: Cummins introduces QSK78 Centum Series to the 50 Hz market
moves.summary: New 50 Hz HHP Centum gensets on the QSK78 platform, up to 3500 kVA standby and 3300 kVA continuous for data centres, with PowerCommand 3400, Centum Transmission Drive, Tier 2 and Low NOx options and HVO compatibility, announced from Daventry, UK for Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia Pacific and Latin America.
moves.analysis: Extends the data-centre-optimised Centum footprint to the 50 Hz UAE and Kuwait markets where the C2750D5 and C3000D5 previously carried the QSK78 range. Cummins Arabia should obtain the model data sheets and position the 3300 kVA continuous rating against Cat 3516E and mtu 20V4000 offers in UAE hyperscale tenders.

moves.headline: Cummins Q2 2026: Power Systems sales up 19 percent to USD 2.3 billion, outlook raised
moves.summary: Q2 2026 revenue USD 9.5 billion (up 9 percent), net income USD 932 million, EBITDA 17.5 percent. Power Systems sales USD 2.3 billion (up 19 percent) with EBITDA USD 552 million (24.5 percent) on robust data centre standby orders; full year revenue growth guidance raised to 10 to 13 percent.
moves.analysis: Strong global order intake tightens HHP lead times and pricing power for the parent. For Cummins Arabia the implication is lead time discipline in Gulf bids and early engagement with consultants so that Saudi and UAE projects are in the order book before slots fill.

moves.headline: Cummins wins 5 MWh BESS supply for a large US data centre
moves.summary: Cummins selected to supply LFP battery energy storage systems with 5 MWh nominal capacity for a large US data centre project, its largest BESS deployment to date, to manage AI-driven load fluctuations and support utility interconnection requirements.
moves.analysis: Validates BESS as a data centre product line, not only a remote-power line. Cummins Arabia can bundle BESS with genset blocks in KSA and UAE data centre proposals to address load-following and interconnection ramp requirements.

moves.headline: HSK78G certified for hydraulic fracturing (EPA Tier 2 mobile off-highway)
moves.summary: The 78 litre, 12 cylinder HSK78G natural gas engine, rated 3000 bhp, received EPA Tier 2 large spark-ignition mobile off-highway certification for well servicing, joining the Spark-Ignited Pumping Power portfolio.
moves.analysis: Relevant to Cummins Arabia's oil and gas engine business as Saudi unconventional gas programmes expand; also confirms the HSK78G platform's power density that underpins the C2000N gas genset range offered in the Gulf.

CATERPIL.title: Caterpillar order surge strains its global manufacturing network, shares near record on data-centre power demand
CATERPIL.description: Kalkine reports that data-centre demand for on-site power pushed Caterpillar toward record territory around 11 Oct, with grid-connection delays pushing operators to build their own generation. The surge in orders has tested capacity of Caterpillar's global manufacturing network.
CATERPIL.analysis: Strained Cat output supports Cummins Arabia's case for Gulf data-centre prime/standby power where delivery dates matter (no figures given in the article, so treat as directional). Action: ask Gulf hyperscale and colocation contacts for their Cat quoted dates and counter with Cummins slots.

CATERPIL.title: Caterpillar shares fall 5.75% on 7 Oct; management says turbine orders already extend into 2029-2030
CATERPIL.description: FX Leaders reports Caterpillar closed down 5.75% at USD 813.83 on 7 Oct despite a USD 72bn backlog, up 92% year on year. It says growth increasingly comes from large generators for AI data centres, with production of large engines and turbines being increased.
CATERPIL.analysis: Cat's growth is increasingly large data-centre generators and turbines, and its management says turbine orders already extend to 2029-2030, so long Cat lead times on large sets are likely. Action: give data-centre buyers considering Cat Cummins Arabia's confirmed lead times.

CATERPIL.title: Caterpillar G3500K gas gensets selected for off-grid Kazakhstan gold mine via dealer Borusan Cat
CATERPIL.description: West Gold Mining chose two Cat G3500K gas gensets for a site nearly 300 km from the nearest city in Aktobe, supplied through Cat dealer Borusan Cat. Small in scale, but it shows the G3500K being sold for prime off-grid power.
CATERPIL.analysis: Cat dealers are positioning G3500K gas sets for remote prime power, the same pitch Gulf dealers can make for remote oil, gas and mining sites in KSA. Action: confirm Cummins Arabia has a comparable gas-genset reference for remote KSA industrial sites.

CATERPIL.title: Caterpillar restarts 10 MW gas engine (1.5 GW capacity), shipments Q4 2026; large gas-engine orders booked into 2028-29
CATERPIL.description: Trefis reports Caterpillar is resuming its 10 MW gas engine and plans to bring about 1.5 GW of capacity back online, with shipments expected from Q4 2026. For gas engines used as a site's main power source, the wait for new orders reaches the back half of 2028 into 2029, and some customers order out to 2030.
CATERPIL.analysis: Caterpillar quoting 2028-29 slots for prime-power gas engines is a delivery-time opening for Cummins Arabia on Gulf data-centre and industrial prime-power projects, where owners cannot wait years (our inference; Gulf lead times not verified). Action: price and publish firm Cummins gas/diesel genset delivery windows for KSA/UAE before Cat's 10 MW restart ships in Q4.

CATERPIL.title: Caterpillar power-generation sales up 72% in Q2 as backlog hits USD 72bn, 92% above last year
CATERPIL.description: Trefis summarises Caterpillar's Q2 2026 data-centre-driven power-generation growth: retail sales of power generation equipment rose 72% and backlog reached USD 72bn. Management also raised the full-year 2026 sales outlook to mid-to-high teens growth.
CATERPIL.analysis: Caterpillar's gensets are being absorbed by hyperscale demand, so its Gulf dealers (Zahid, Al-Bahar) compete for the same constrained factory slots as Cummins Arabia. Action: use Cummins' delivery slots in KSA/UAE data-centre bids as a selling point against Cat dealers' longer allocations (secondary source; confirm against Caterpillar's Q2 release).

ROLLSROY.title: Rolls-Royce licenses MAKEEN to build mtu Series 2000 engines in Saudi Arabia, first high-speed engine licence in the Kingdom
ROLLSROY.description: Rolls-Royce Power Systems signed an Individual License Agreement with Saudi Engines Manufacturing Company (MAKEEN; Aramco, HD Hyundai, Dussur) for local manufacture and assembly of mtu Series 2000 marine engines, building on a November 2023 framework agreement. No volumes, investment or start date are disclosed; rail is named as the next target after marine.
ROLLSROY.analysis: This is a marine and rail engine licence, not a genset or data-centre deal, so it does not hit Cummins Arabia's standby power sales today. It does show Rolls-Royce building a local-content position with Aramco-linked partners in KSA, which can later help mtu in localisation-scored power tenders. Action: ask the KSA team to track whether MAKEEN's scope extends from Series 2000 to Series 4000 genset engines, and to prepare Cummins' own local-content evidence for Saudi tenders.

ROLLSROY.title: Rolls-Royce opens mtu Remote Monitoring Centre in Arcola, Italy, covering power generation plants as well as marine
ROLLSROY.description: Rolls-Royce commissioned a Remote Monitoring Centre in Arcola, Italy, the first outside Berlin, for vessels with mtu engines and for power generation plants, starting with marine and yacht fleets. Regional Remote Monitoring Hubs are planned, and the company calls it the start of a global roll-out.
ROLLSROY.analysis: No Gulf centre is named, and the first customers are Italian marine users, so there is no near-term effect on Cummins Arabia. A regional monitoring hub for mtu power plants would strengthen the service offer of mtu distributors such as Al Mulla in Kuwait. Action: check that Cummins Arabia's remote-monitoring offer for data-centre and hospital customers matches this, and watch for a Middle East hub.

ROLLSROY.title: Energy Vault contracts 275 MW of Rolls-Royce mtu engine capacity for hyperscale AI sites, deliveries H2 2027 to H1 2028
ROLLSROY.description: Energy Vault announced on 10 Sep 2026 that it secured and fully contracted 275 MW of reciprocating engine generation capacity using Rolls-Royce mtu technology, financed by Eagle Point Credit Management. Deliveries start in the second half of 2027 and run through the first half of 2028.
ROLLSROY.analysis: Third-party buyers are now reserving mtu engine slots 15 to 21 months out for AI and hyperscale power, which shows mtu output for 2027 to 2028 is being absorbed by US demand. That limits how much mtu capacity is free for Gulf data-centre bids in the same window, which supports Cummins' delivery-time argument. Action: quote firm Cummins delivery slots in Gulf data-centre proposals and compare them against mtu's 2027 to 2028 availability.

REHLKO.title: Rehlko redesigns KG Series gas gensets, six EPA-certified models of 80-200 kW at 60 Hz
REHLKO.description: Rehlko introduced six redesigned KG Series gaseous generators (KG80 to KG200) for 60 Hz standby use, on 6.2 L and 10.3 L Rehlko engines with a 2-year warranty extendable to 5 years. Target sites include healthcare, water treatment and telecom.
REHLKO.analysis: This is a small-set, US-emissions-certified 60 Hz range, below Cummins Arabia's data-centre core, so direct Gulf impact is limited and applies only to the 60 Hz parts of KSA. Cummins Arabia should check whether Rehlko dealers in KSA start quoting KG gas sets for hospital and water-utility standby.

REHLKO.title: Rehlko launches programme to double Changzhou backup power capacity from 5.5 GW to 11 GW
REHLKO.description: Changzhou builds generator systems from 6 kW to 4,000 kW and key components, serving China, Southeast Asia, EMEA and Latin America; CEO called it a critical hub for EMEA. The 11 GW target is to be reached without expanding the footprint; first pass yield up from 93% to 98%.
REHLKO.analysis: Changzhou explicitly serves EMEA, so Gulf distributors can now source KD Series up to 4,000 kW from a plant with 11 GW annual capacity. This is a direct supply and price lever against Cummins Arabia in KSA, UAE and Kuwait data centre and industrial tenders. Cummins Arabia should benchmark Changzhou-sourced pricing on 1.5 MW to 3 MW sets and reinforce total cost of ownership and local service arguments.

REHLKO.title: Rehlko invests EUR 12 million to expand Cholet, France switchgear plant
REHLKO.description: 56% expansion of manufacturing space over five years, 30% lead time reduction on completion in November 2026, over 100 new jobs; Cholet builds LV main switchboards, generator switchboards and control panels for data centre solutions.
REHLKO.analysis: Rehlko is shortening lead times on the paralleling switchgear that ships with large genset packages to EMEA including the Gulf. Cummins Arabia should quantify its own switchgear lead times and partner capacity so it is not outpaced on complete package delivery.

MITSUBIS.title: MHIET sets hydrogen co-firing specifications for KU series gas engines (3.65 to 5.75 MW)
MITSUBIS.description: Up to 50% hydrogen by volume on 18KU30SI class engines for cogeneration, grid stability and power wheeling, available for new units and retrofits with minimal design change.
MITSUBIS.analysis: KU series competes with Cummins HSK78G and larger gas engines in industrial CHP and grid support. Gulf gas engine demand from data centres and utilities is growing and Mitsubishi now has a hydrogen-ready spec to offer. Cummins Arabia should sharpen its own fuel flexibility story.

MITSUBIS.title: Mitsubishi Power wins boiler supply for heavy oil to gas fuel conversion at Jeddah South and Shuqaiq plants
MITSUBIS.description: Contract from Saudi Energy for dual fuel conversion of four units at each of two 2.9 GW west coast plants, with Dar Al Balad as local EPC and Mitsubishi Corporation Machinery as agent.
MITSUBIS.analysis: Context only: it deepens Mitsubishi's standing with Saudi utility buyers and local EPCs. No genset scope. Cummins Arabia should note that Dar Al Balad and similar EPCs now have a working Mitsubishi relationship that could extend to backup power packages.

MITSUBIS.title: MHIET 500 kW class 100% hydrogen engine generator set reaches commercial readiness level
MITSUBIS.description: 435 kWe at 1,500 rpm from a 6-cylinder 170 mm bore engine on pure hydrogen, tested at Sagamihara with green hydrogen; only long-term durability evaluation remains.
MITSUBIS.analysis: Relevant to NEOM and UAE hydrogen showcase projects where zero carbon backup power will be specified. Cummins Arabia should be ready to discuss Cummins hydrogen engine roadmap when consultants raise this.

WEICHAIB.title: Baudouin hosts regional prefect at Cassis, France site; expansion and investment projects discussed
WEICHAIB.description: Baudouin said CEO Fabrizio Mozzi hosted the Provence-Alpes-Cote d'Azur prefect and Cassis mayor on 14 Sep 2026 for a tour of engine and power-generation assembly, including data-centre units. Discussions covered expansion projects and ongoing investment at Cassis, Baudouin's French plant for its high-horsepower data-centre gensets; no figures were given.
WEICHAIB.analysis: Baudouin is still expanding French genset integration, which supports its pitch of shorter lead times and French origin for data-centre buyers. Cummins Arabia should treat this as a minor signal and track whether Baudouin quotes sub-12-month Gulf deliveries in live tenders.

WEICHAIB.title: Brokerage: Generac-Amazon deal is positive for Weichai; Weichai targets 4,000 AIDC diesel gensets in 2026, 6,000 in 2027
WEICHAIB.description: A 17 Sep 2026 brokerage note says Baudouin, a wholly owned Weichai subsidiary, is an important engine supplier to Generac, so the up-to-US$8bn Amazon agreement gives Weichai visibility on AIDC orders. It cites Weichai targets of 4,000 (2026) and 6,000 (2027) AIDC diesel gensets, 200 and 2,000 gas gensets, and gas-genset capacity rising to 9,000 units.
WEICHAIB.analysis: Weichai is planning a large step-up in data-centre genset output, with a US focus, which could tighten Baudouin engine availability for others but also builds a volume base for Gulf offers. Cummins Arabia should monitor whether Baudouin quotes shorter Gulf lead times than the 18-24 months seen for large sets and, if so, sharpen Cummins' delivery-slot messaging to hyperscalers.

WEICHAIB.title: Weichai H1 2026: data centre genset sales above 1,400 units, more than all of 2025
WEICHAIB.description: Weichai reported H1 2026 revenue of RMB 123.16 billion (up 8.8 percent) and net profit of RMB 7.7 billion (up 36.5 percent). Data centre generator sales exceeded 1,400 units in the half, surpassing full-year 2025, with M-series high-power engines at 6,700 units (up 31.5 percent). Baudouin signed a strategic cooperation with a major French customer.
WEICHAIB.analysis: Run-rate of roughly 2,800 data centre gensets a year puts Weichai among the largest volume producers of data centre sets worldwide. Gulf hyperscalers that buy globally will see Weichai and Baudouin on approved vendor lists, which erodes the reference advantage Cummins holds in the region.

WEICHAIB.title: Yuchai (China Yuchai International, Singapore HQ, NYSE CYD) is the second Chinese engine OEM whose genset engines appear in low-cost Gulf packages
WEICHAIB.description: China Yuchai International, through Guangxi Yuchai Machinery, produces engines for generator sets alongside marine and industrial engines. No verified 2025 to 2026 Gulf distributor announcement, Gulf project or data centre product from Yuchai was found in this research.
WEICHAIB.analysis: Yuchai-powered sets from Chinese packagers compete at the low end of Gulf tenders (typically below 1,000 kVA). Cummins Arabia's exposure is in price-led utility, telecom and construction bids in KSA and Kuwait rather than in data centres. Track Chinese packager registrations on Etimad and CAPT rather than Yuchai itself.
WEICHAIB.date_note: Context entry; no dated Gulf event found

PERKINSF.title: Perkins 5016 enters production: 1,400-2,500 kVA at 50 Hz, runs on 100% HVO, built in Stafford and Aurangabad
PERKINSF.description: Perkins' 5016 is in production, completing the 5000 Series at 6, 8, 12 and 16 cylinders, rated up to 2,500 kVA standby and 2,250 kVA prime. It is built for ISO 8528 G3 / NFPA 110 load acceptance, runs on B20 or 100% HVO, and has 750-hour service intervals.
PERKINSF.analysis: 50 Hz rating and 100% HVO capability fit Gulf data-centre specifications, so FG Wilson can quote large 50 Hz sets in KSA/UAE once 5016 sets are available there (Gulf availability not stated). Action: prepare a one-page 5016 comparison for Cummins Arabia's tenders and consultant meetings.

PERKINSF.title: Perkins markets 5016 engine for data centres, healthcare, airports and remote sites in Africa and worldwide
PERKINSF.description: African Review reports Perkins' 5016 is in production in India and the UK and is offered to Africa and global markets, targeting data centres, healthcare, airports and remote worksites. It uses two smaller turbochargers per bank for load acceptance and takes B20 or 100% HVO.
PERKINSF.analysis: The article names Africa and 'worldwide' but not the Middle East, so Gulf availability of the 5016 is unconfirmed. Action: ask Gulf channel contacts whether FG Wilson and Perkins OEMs have 5016-based sets quoted for KSA/UAE.

PERKINSF.title: Perkins to show 5016 large electronic-injection genset engine at Tech Week Singapore 2026
PERKINSF.description: Perkins said it will exhibit the 5016 large electronic fuel injection engine at Tech Week Singapore 2026 (stand L20), positioning the sets for data centres, power stations, rental and hospitals. The release gives no kVA, emissions or availability figures.
PERKINSF.analysis: Perkins keeps pushing the 5016 (FG Wilson sets) as a data-centre option at the upper end of its range, a price-led alternative in Gulf colocation and edge sites. Cummins Arabia should compare 5016-based FG Wilson quotes against its own 1.5-2.5 MVA offers on current bids.

PERKINSF.title: FG Wilson Catalyst 2026: 60th anniversary global dealer conference in Belfast
PERKINSF.description: FG Wilson gathered its global dealer network, customers and staff in Belfast's Titanic Quarter for a week of strategy, innovation and growth sessions and a Product Discovery Zone. No new product launches were announced.
PERKINSF.analysis: A dealer conference of this scale signals a channel re-energising exercise. Expect dealer targets and campaign activity in the Gulf over the next 12 months, especially from FG Wilson (Engineering) FZE and TAMGO. Cummins Arabia should expect sharper FG Wilson pricing in the 500 to 1,500 kVA commercial band.

PERKINSF.title: Perkins launches 61-litre V16 5016 genset engine for data centres, says demand 'insatiable'
PERKINSF.description: Perkins unveiled the 5016, which tops its 5000 Series (23 to 61 litres, 750 to 2,500 kVA), for backup power at data centres, hospitals and mining. The article cites Skanska expecting generator prices of 100 kW to 4.5 MW to rise 8-10% in 2026 and Perkins saying it has capacity to meet 5000 Series demand.
PERKINSF.analysis: A 2,500 kVA Perkins engine lets FG Wilson quote larger data-centre sets than before, so it can move into projects where Cummins Arabia's high-kVA sets compete (the article says Perkins has capacity to meet 5000 Series demand). Action: benchmark 5016-based sets (1,400-2,500 kVA, 50 Hz) against Cummins' equivalent on price, load acceptance and lead time.

PERKINSF.title: FG Wilson appoints Green Power International as India distributor, targeting data centres and healthcare
PERKINSF.description: GPI (founded 2002, 750+ staff) was named authorised FG Wilson distributor for 40-2,500 kVA diesel sets and lifecycle support in India on 10 Sep. FG Wilson manufactures in India, Brazil and China and sells in over 150 countries.
PERKINSF.analysis: This is a paid press release for India, not the Gulf, but it shows FG Wilson adding a data-centre-focused channel and using Indian production capacity that also supplies other export markets. Action: no Gulf change; watch FG Wilson UAE and Saudi distributor announcements (none found in this window).

GENERAC.title: KeyBanc upgrades Generac to Overweight on Amazon contract; Amazon seen as about 1.6bn of 2028 data-centre revenue
GENERAC.description: Goldesel reports on 8 Oct 2026 that KeyBanc analyst Jeffrey Hammond upgraded Generac from Sector Weight to Overweight with a $280 target. It says Amazon is expected to account for about $1.6bn of the $3.0-3.2bn data-centre revenue Generac projects for 2028.
GENERAC.analysis: Generac's 2028 data-centre target of $3.0-3.2bn, with about half from one customer, is mostly a US story and shows limited Gulf exposure. Track whether the share of non-Amazon hyperscalers grows; Cummins Arabia should treat Generac as a Gulf bid rival only once a regional partner is named.

GENERAC.title: Generac targets more than $1.25bn annual large-megawatt generator capacity as Amazon deal lifts attention to scale-up
GENERAC.description: Data Center Frontier reports that Generac expects more than $1.25bn of annual large-megawatt generator manufacturing capacity, with new manufacturing and packaging facilities supporting data-centre deployments. The deal brings initial deliveries of about $2.4bn during 2027 and 2028.
GENERAC.analysis: Added Generac capacity (Q4 2026 target) will compete for the same large diesel genset and enclosure supply chain, while Amazon takes the first slots through 2028. Cummins Arabia should check allocation and lead times for 2-3.5 MW sets with Cummins supply before Gulf data-centre bids in 2027 and quote firm dates.

GENERAC.title: Amazon's USD 8bn is a warrant-vesting threshold, not a guaranteed Generac order
GENERAC.description: TradeVulcan reports the Amazon agreement was signed on 16 Sep 2026 with initial deliveries of $2.4bn in 2027-2028. It stresses that the $8bn is a payment threshold for full warrant vesting and not a committed purchase order.
GENERAC.analysis: The $8bn is a warrant-vesting threshold and the $2.4bn is expected initial deliveries, not a committed order, so headlines overstate the near-term threat to other suppliers including Cummins. Brief Cummins Arabia sales not to quote $8bn to customers as committed volume.

GENERAC.title: Generac signs long-term Amazon backup-generator supply agreement, issues warrant tied to up to $8bn of payments
GENERAC.description: Generac and Amazon executed a long-term supply agreement on 16 Sep 2026 with initial deliveries of $2.4bn expected in 2027 and 2028. Amazon received a warrant for up to 1,693,745 Generac shares (307,954 vested immediately), with the remainder vesting as gross payments reach up to $8bn.
GENERAC.analysis: Generac now has a named, equity-linked hyperscaler customer, which shows a US hyperscaler will tie a generator supplier to itself through 2028. The filing names no Gulf scope, so the direct effect on Cummins Arabia is indirect; ask Cummins global account teams which hyperscalers building in KSA/UAE have framework deals and whether Generac was quoted.

GENERAC.title: Generac executive: data-centre customers now considering battery energy storage alongside gensets
GENERAC.description: Microgrid Knowledge (10 Sep 2026) profiles Generac's push into the industrial compute age, covering its Illinois packaging site purchase and Enercon enclosure acquisition. A Generac executive says data-centre customers are weighing battery storage to handle erratic AI loads.
GENERAC.analysis: Generac is positioning gensets plus BESS and controls as one data-centre package, which is the offer Gulf operators will compare against Cummins. Cummins Arabia should have a genset-plus-BESS reference design ready for UAE and KSA data-centre RFPs.

VOLVOPEN.title: Volvo Penta publishes data centre backup power positioning: Tier 4 Final platform, modular approach, independent partner to OEMs and system integrators
VOLVOPEN.description: Volvo Penta states it collaborates with OEMs and system integrators on flexible data centre backup power, cites automotive-scale production for shorter lead times, stackable modular configurations and HVO100 compatibility for all engines built since 2016.
VOLVOPEN.analysis: Volvo's data centre pitch is modular many-small-units, which fits edge and enterprise sites rather than the hyperscale campuses driving Gulf demand. Cummins Arabia should watch packager bids on edge data centres in UAE.

VOLVOPEN.title: Volvo Penta reports doubled industrial engine sales in North America and targets the data centre boom
VOLVOPEN.description: Volvo Penta said North American industrial engine sales doubled and highlighted backup power and BESS solutions for data centres ahead of CONEXPO 2026.
VOLVOPEN.analysis: Growth is US-led. No Gulf-specific volume signal found.

VOLVOPEN.title: Volvo Penta introduces G17 natural gas engine for power generation, aimed at data centres and utilities
VOLVOPEN.description: First Volvo Penta natural gas genset engine, framed as lower-emission, scalable backup power for data centres, utilities and mission-critical infrastructure.
VOLVOPEN.analysis: Adds a gas option at the 17 litre node for packagers. In the Gulf the relevant overlap is with Cummins gas gensets in the 400 to 700 kW band for oil and gas and utility sites in KSA and Kuwait.

Cummins Arabia.title: Cummins plans 55 GW capacity by 2030 for about USD 450m of investment, per Investor Day figures
Cummins Arabia.description: Critic blog TCAP (The Cummins Accountability Project, 2 Oct 2026) restates Cummins Investor Day figures: USD 450m to add 20 GW of high-horsepower engine and generator capacity, taking planned capacity to 55 GW by 2030; data-centre revenue about USD 5bn at the 2026 guidance midpoint, rising above USD 9bn by 2030. It also cites Goldman Sachs: only 50-60% of scheduled near-term US data-centre capacity arrives on time.
Cummins Arabia.analysis: More Cummins large-genset capacity should ease supply from 2027-28. Plan Cummins Arabia's 2027 quotes on current lead times and re-check allocation after the Q3 results (estimated 3 Nov 2026, not confirmed).

Cummins Arabia.title: EquipmentShare and Cummins agree multi-year fleet deal targeting 1 GW of mobile gas power
Cummins Arabia.description: Announced 29 Sep 2026, the agreement makes EquipmentShare a rental and distribution channel for Cummins gas gensets (C1400N6C, 60Hz), with fleet growth to 1 GW for temporary power, microgrid and BESS. The release is US-focused and does not mention the Middle East.
Cummins Arabia.analysis: It shows Cummins backing a gas-led rental model with large 60Hz units, a template for Saudi mega-project temporary power, where rental is the main route. Review whether Cummins Arabia's rental offering and gas-genset stock can match this, since the product here is 60Hz and the Gulf mostly uses 50Hz.

Cummins Arabia.title: HSK78G certified for hydraulic fracturing (EPA Tier 2 mobile off-highway)
Cummins Arabia.description: The 78 litre, 12 cylinder HSK78G natural gas engine, rated 3000 bhp, received EPA Tier 2 large spark-ignition mobile off-highway certification for well servicing, joining the Spark-Ignited Pumping Power portfolio.
Cummins Arabia.analysis: Relevant to Cummins Arabia's oil and gas engine business as Saudi unconventional gas programmes expand; also confirms the HSK78G platform's power density that underpins the C2000N gas genset range offered in the Gulf.

Cummins Arabia.title: Cummins Inc. says data-centre power demand 'remains robust' as Q2 sales hit record $9.5bn
Cummins Arabia.description: A Motley Fool review of Cummins (published 10 Sep 2026) cites record Q2 2026 revenue of $9.5 billion, full-year growth guidance raised to 10-13%, and Power Systems sales up 19%. It notes the Circe Energy gas-genset deal and a US data-centre BESS selection.
Cummins Arabia.analysis: Cummins Inc. reports record sales and robust data-centre power demand, so large-genset factory slots stay tight. Cummins Arabia should ask Cummins Power Systems for confirmed 2027 allocation on its hyperscale pipeline.
